modules.App:
--[[
	App — the ZAAL Assets panel.

	Left: every skin in this place, grouped by slot, with its status, tier and shop
	state; search and filters. Right: the selected skin — a 3D thumbnail, what it
	needs before the shop, Preview on the ship, Setup (face / light / name text),
	Tier (website + game), the checks, what Approve would change, and Approve.

	Nothing runs per frame. Live hooks: Selection.SelectionChanged while the panel
	is open, and the preview's model watch while a skin is being previewed.
]]

local Selection = game:GetService("Selection")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")

local Theme = require(script.Parent.Theme)
local ShipSkins = require(script.Parent.ShipSkins)
local ToolSkins = require(script.Parent.ToolSkins)
local Website = require(script.Parent.Website)
local Preview = require(script.Parent.Preview)
local Setup = require(script.Parent.Setup)
local Slots = require(script.Parent.Slots)
local Paint = require(script.Parent.Paint)
local PreviewTab = require(script.Parent.PreviewTab)
local Review = require(script.Parent.Review)
local Guide = require(script.Parent.Guide)
local ImportTab = require(script.Parent.ImportTab)
local Importer = require(script.Parent.Importer)

local LOGO = "rbxassetid://92946926368629" -- the game's wheel-face symbol (docs/notes/tooling/brand-assets.md)

local new, T, col = Theme.new, Theme.text, Theme.color

local App = {}

local state = {
	mode = nil, -- "ship" | "tool"
	skins = {},
	results = {},
	selected = nil,
	filter = "all",
	query = "",
	collapsed = {}, -- [slot] = true
	previewing = nil, -- the skin shown on the preview ship
	previewItem = 1,
	showRow = false,
	busy = false,
}
local ui = {}

local STATE_LABEL = { new = "NEW", same = "IN SHOP", changed = "CHANGED" }
local STATE_COLOR = { new = col.accent, same = col.ok, changed = col.warn }

local function module() return state.mode == "tool" and ToolSkins or ShipSkins end

local function worst(r)
	local lvl = "ok"
	for _, c in ipairs(r.checks) do
		if c.level == "bad" then return "bad" end
		if c.level == "warn" then lvl = "warn" end
	end
	return lvl
end

local function toast(text, level)
	if not ui.status then return end
	ui.status.Text = text
	ui.statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = level and col[level] or col.info
end

local function expectedItemId(skin)
	return (skin.kind == "tool" and "Tool:" or "Ship:") .. skin.slot .. ":" .. skin.key
end

local function tierOf(skin, r)
	local web = Website.get(skin.key, skin.slot)
	if web and web.tier then return Slots.TIERS[web.tier] end
	if skin.kind == "tool" then return r and r.want and r.want.Tier end
	local cat = ShipSkins.catalogData()
	local e = cat and cat[skin.slot] and cat[skin.slot][skin.key]
	return e and e.tier
end

local function inspectOne(skin)
	local web = Website.get(skin.key, skin.slot)
	local r = module().inspect(skin, web or nil)
	state.results[skin] = r
	return r
end

local renderList, renderDetail
local renderBodyList, renderBodyDetail -- the Body colours tab (defined further down)

-- LIST --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function matches(skin)
	local q = state.query:lower()
	if q ~= "" and not skin.key:lower():find(q, 1, true) and not skin.slot:lower():find(q, 1, true) then return false end
	local r = state.results[skin]
	if not r then return true end
	if state.filter == "new" then return r.status == "new" end
	if state.filter == "changed" then return r.status == "changed" end
	if state.filter == "problems" then return worst(r) == "bad" end
	if state.filter == "review" then return Review.get(skin.model) ~= nil end
	return true
end

renderList = function()
	-- the filter chips belong to the skin lists: hidden on Preview and Import, whose list moves up
	if ui.filters then
		local own = state.mode ~= "preview" and state.mode ~= "import"
		ui.filters.Visible = own
		ui.list.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, own and 78 or 40)
		ui.list.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, own and -78 or -40)
	end
	if state.mode == "body" then return renderBodyList() end
	if state.mode == "preview" then return PreviewTab.renderList() end
	if state.mode == "import" then return ImportTab.renderList() end
	local list = ui.list
	for _, c in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
		if not c:IsA("UIListLayout") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	local counts = { all = #state.skins, new = 0, changed = 0, problems = 0, review = 0 }
	for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do
		if Review.get(s.model) then counts.review += 1 end
	end
	for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do
		local r = state.results[s]
		if r then
			if r.status == "new" then counts.new += 1 end
			if r.status == "changed" then counts.changed += 1 end
			if worst(r) == "bad" then counts.problems += 1 end
		end
	end
	for key, b in pairs(ui.filterButtons) do
		b.Text = ({ all = "All", new = "New", changed = "Changed", problems = "Problems", review = "Review" })[key] .. "  " .. counts[key]
	end

	local order = 0
	local groups, groupOrder = {}, {}
	for _, skin in ipairs(state.skins) do
		if matches(skin) then
			if not groups[skin.slot] then
				groups[skin.slot] = {}
				table.insert(groupOrder, skin.slot)
			end
			table.insert(groups[skin.slot], skin)
		end
	end
	for _, slot in ipairs(groupOrder) do
		order += 1
		local collapsed = state.collapsed[slot]
		local head = new("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28), LayoutOrder = order }, {
			T((collapsed and "+  " or "–  ") .. slot:upper(), { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = col.dim,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 0) }),
			T(tostring(#groups[slot]), { FontFace = Theme.fontMedium, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = col.dim,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Size = UDim2.new(0, 36, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 0),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None }),
		})
		head.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			state.collapsed[slot] = not state.collapsed[slot] or nil
			renderList()
		end)
		head.Parent = list
		if not collapsed then
			for _, skin in ipairs(groups[slot]) do
				order += 1
				local r = state.results[skin]
				local sel = state.selected == skin
				local lvl = r and worst(r) or "info"
				local tier = tierOf(skin, r)
				local row = new("TextButton", {
					Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = order,
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), BackgroundColor3 = sel and col.selected or col.bg,
					BackgroundTransparency = sel and 0 or 1,
				}, {
					Theme.corner(6),
					new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -4),
						BackgroundColor3 = col[lvl] or col.info, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, { Theme.corner(4) }),
					T(skin.key, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -150, 1, 0),
						AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, TextWrapped = false, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
						FontFace = sel and Theme.fontMedium or Theme.font }),
				})
				local chips = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 20), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X },
					{ Theme.hlist(4) })
				local hl = chips:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
				hl.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
				if tier and Theme.TIER[tier] then
					Theme.pill(tier:sub(1, 1), Theme.TIER[tier], { LayoutOrder = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20),
						AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center }).Parent = chips
				end
				if Review.get(skin.model) then
					Theme.pill("REVIEW", col.warn, { LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = chips
				end
				if r then
					Theme.pill(STATE_LABEL[r.status], STATE_COLOR[r.status], { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = chips
				end
				chips.Parent = row
				row.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if state.selected ~= skin then row.BackgroundTransparency = 0 row.BackgroundColor3 = col.hover end end)
				row.MouseLeave:Connect(function() if state.selected ~= skin then row.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end end)
				row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					state.selected = skin
					state.showRow = false
					renderList()
					renderDetail()
				end)
				row.Parent = list
			end
		end
	end
	if order == 0 then
		T(state.mode and "No skins match." or "Open the Assets place (ship skins) or PVP&NPC ASSETS (tool skins).",
			{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = list
	end
end

-- DETAIL ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function thumbnail(model)
	local vf = new("ViewportFrame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(112, 112), BackgroundColor3 = col.raised,
		BorderSizePixel = 0, LightDirection = Vector3.new(-1, -1, -0.5), Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 175) },
		{ Theme.corner(10) })
	local ok = pcall(function()
		local copy = model:Clone()
		for _, d in ipairs(copy:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Light") then d:Destroy() end
		end
		if copy:IsA("BasePart") then
			local m = Instance.new("Model")
			copy.Parent = m
			copy = m
		end
		copy.Parent = vf
		local cf, size = copy:GetBoundingBox()
		local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
		cam.FieldOfView = 30
		local dist = size.Magnitude * 1.9
		-- from the FRONT: a model faces its LookVector (the camera sat on -LookVector, so every
		-- door, board, lantern, wheel and anchor rendered from its back)
		cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position + (cf.LookVector + cf.RightVector * 0.7 + Vector3.new(0, 0.45, 0)).Unit * dist, cf.Position)
		cam.Parent = vf
		vf.CurrentCamera = cam
	end)
	if not ok then T("no preview", { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None }).Parent = vf end
	return vf
end

local function checkLine(c, order, skin)
	local mark = ({ ok = "✓", warn = "!", bad = "✕", info = "•" })[c.level]
	local f = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = order })
	new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20), BackgroundColor3 = col[c.level] or col.info, BackgroundTransparency = 0.82,
		BorderSizePixel = 0 }, { Theme.corner(10),
		T(mark, { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = col[c.level] or col.info, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center }) }).Parent = f
	T(c.text, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 1), Size = UDim2.new(1, c.fix and -230 or -30, 0, 0),
		TextColor3 = c.level == "info" and col.dim or col.text }).Parent = f
	if c.fix then
		local b = Theme.button(c.fix.label, "secondary", function()
			local ok, err = ShipSkins.runFix(c.fix)
			toast(ok and (c.fix.label .. " — done (Ctrl+Z undoes it).") or ("Fix failed: " .. tostring(err)), ok and "ok" or "bad")
			inspectOne(skin)
			renderList()
			renderDetail()
		end, { Position = UDim2.new(1, -220, 0, -2), Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 26), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, TextSize = 12,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd })
		b.Parent = f
	end
	return f
end

local function refreshSkin(skin)
	inspectOne(skin)
	renderList()
	renderDetail()
end

-- the skin's theme: its first tag that is not a colour-group or tool tag
local function themeOf(skin)
	if skin.kind == "ship" then return ShipSkins.themeOf(skin) end
	for _, t in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTags(skin.model)) do
		if t:sub(1, 12) ~= "SkinSurface_" and not t:match("Skin$") then return t end
	end
	return nil
end

-- the body in the skin's theme colours (or back to default)
local function paintBody(skin)
	local theme = themeOf(skin)
	if state.bodyPaint == false or not theme then
		Preview.paint(nil)
		state.paintSource = state.bodyPaint == false and "Default body colours." or "No theme tag, so the body keeps its default colours."
		return
	end
	local palette, source = Preview.paletteFor(theme, ShipSkins.catalogData())
	Preview.paint(palette)
	state.paintSource = palette and ("Body painted with " .. source .. ".")
		or (source or ("No body colours found for " .. theme .. " — no catalogue paint rows and no colour donor in workspace.ship tagged " .. theme .. "."))
end

-- DRAFT: while a skin is previewed, every change to its Assets model shows on the ship at once
-- but stays a draft. Apply keeps it; Revert puts the model back as it was when the preview
-- started; stopping the preview, previewing another skin or closing the panel reverts what was
-- not applied. (A Studio File → Save in between still saves the draft: the edits are real
-- instances — the plugin cannot hold a save back.)
local draftMuted = false -- true while Revert itself rewrites the model

-- what Revert puts back on a skin that is a single MeshPart (a sail) rather than a Model
local PART_PROPS = { "CFrame", "Size", "PivotOffset", "Color", "Transparency", "Material", "TextureID", "DoubleSided" }

local function snapshotOf(model)
	local was = model.Archivable
	model.Archivable = true
	local copy = model:Clone()
	model.Archivable = was
	local snap = { copy = copy, attrs = model:GetAttributes(), tags = CollectionService:GetTags(model) }
	if model:IsA("Model") then
		snap.primary = model.PrimaryPart and model.PrimaryPart.Name
		snap.pivot = model.WorldPivot
	else
		-- a sail skin is ONE MeshPart, not a Model: keep the part's own look and place
		local props = {}
		for _, k in ipairs(PART_PROPS) do props[k] = model[k] end
		snap.props = props
	end
	return snap
end

local function restoreModel(model, snap)
	local fresh = snap.copy:Clone()
	-- Parent = nil, not Destroy: a scripted Destroy cannot always be undone (AGENTS.md §10)
	for _, c in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do c.Parent = nil end
	for _, c in ipairs(fresh:GetChildren()) do c.Parent = model end
	fresh:Destroy()
	-- RBX_* attributes (RBX_ReimportId from the importer) belong to Roblox: a plugin may not write
	-- them ("CoreScript permission required"), and the failed write cancelled the whole revert
	for k in pairs(model:GetAttributes()) do
		if snap.attrs[k] == nil and k:sub(1, 4) ~= "RBX_" then model:SetAttribute(k, nil) end
	end
	for k, v in pairs(snap.attrs) do
		if k:sub(1, 4) ~= "RBX_" then model:SetAttribute(k, v) end
	end
	for _, t in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTags(model)) do
		if not table.find(snap.tags, t) then CollectionService:RemoveTag(model, t) end
	end
	for _, t in ipairs(snap.tags) do CollectionService:AddTag(model, t) end
	if model:IsA("Model") then
		model.PrimaryPart = snap.primary and model:FindFirstChild(snap.primary) or nil
		model.WorldPivot = snap.pivot
	elseif snap.props then
		for k, v in pairs(snap.props) do model[k] = v end
	end
end

-- run fn without the live watch counting its model writes as a change (review attributes)
local function draftQuiet(fn)
	draftMuted = true
	local results = table.pack(fn())
	task.defer(function() task.defer(function() draftMuted = false end) end)
	return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
end

-- a review request cleared on the model is final: a later Revert must not bring it back
local function draftForgetReview(model)
	local dr = state.draft
	if not (dr and dr.model == model) then return end
	for k in pairs(dr.snap.attrs) do
		if k:sub(1, 10) == "ZAALReview" then dr.snap.attrs[k] = nil end
	end
end

local function draftApply()
	local dr = state.draft
	if dr and dr.dirty then
		dr.snap = snapshotOf(dr.model)
		dr.dirty = false
	end
end

local function draftRevert()
	local dr = state.draft
	if not (dr and dr.dirty and dr.model.Parent) then return false end
	draftMuted = true
	local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsRevert", "Revert " .. dr.key)
	local ok, err = pcall(restoreModel, dr.model, dr.snap)
	if rec then
		ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, ok and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel)
	end
	dr.dirty = not ok -- a failed revert keeps the changes, and the Apply / Revert bar with them
	-- the live watch re-shows on a deferred call queued during the restore: unmute after it
	task.defer(function() task.defer(function() draftMuted = false end) end)
	if not ok then toast("Could not revert " .. dr.key .. ": " .. tostring(err), "bad") end
	return ok
end

-- leaving the draft: what was not applied goes back
local function draftEnd()
	local dr = state.draft
	if dr and dr.dirty and draftRevert() then
		toast("Changes to " .. dr.key .. " were not applied — reverted.", "warn")
	end
	state.draft = nil
end

-- APPLY / REVERT strip: its own highlighted box, green Apply + orange Revert, always the same
-- height (greyed while nothing changed) — a bar that appeared on the first click pushed every
-- button down under a clicking mouse. Used under the ship controls and in Setup.
local function changesStrip(skin, order)
	local dirty = state.draft and state.draft.model == skin.model and state.draft.dirty == true
	local tone = dirty and col.warn or col.cardStroke
	local box = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = tone, BackgroundTransparency = dirty and 0.85 or 0.6, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		LayoutOrder = order, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46) },
		{ Theme.corner(8), Theme.stroke(tone, 1), Theme.pad(8, 10, 8, 10), Theme.hlist(8) })
	local applyBtn, applyApi = Theme.button("✓  Apply", "ok", function()
		draftApply()
		toast("Applied the changes to " .. skin.key .. ".", "ok")
		renderDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 1, TextSize = 13 })
	applyApi.setEnabled(dirty)
	applyBtn.Parent = box
	local revertBtn, revertApi = Theme.button("↺  Revert", "warn", function()
		if draftRevert() then toast(skin.key .. " is back as it was when the preview started.", "ok") end
		refreshSkin(skin)
	end, { LayoutOrder = 2, TextSize = 13 })
	revertApi.setEnabled(dirty)
	revertBtn.Parent = box
	T(dirty and "Not applied yet — shown on the ship only" or "No changes since the preview started",
		{ TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = dirty and col.warn or col.dim, LayoutOrder = 3, TextWrapped = false,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 1, 0) }).Parent = box
	return box
end

-- MOVE / ROTATE / TURN / SCALE a skin's pieces (Piece: All or one), as pivot edits on the Assets
-- model (one undo step a click) — under the ship preview, and in the Import review
local function adjustRows(skin, parent)
	-- PIECE: All, or one piece (a cannon mouth, a door glass) — its pivot alone
	local allPieces, names = {}, {}
	for _, p in ipairs(skin.model:GetChildren()) do
		if p:IsA("MeshPart") then table.insert(allPieces, p) table.insert(names, p.Name) end
	end
	if state.adjustPiece and not table.find(names, state.adjustPiece) then state.adjustPiece = nil end
	local function chosen()
		if not state.adjustPiece then return allPieces end
		local one = skin.model:FindFirstChild(state.adjustPiece)
		return (one and one:IsA("MeshPart")) and { one } or allPieces
	end
	if #allPieces > 1 then
		local opts = { { "*all", "All" } }
		for _, n in ipairs(names) do table.insert(opts, { n, n }) end
		-- wraps onto more lines: a cannon has six pieces, wider than the panel in one row
		local pickRow = Theme.row(8, 5)
		T("Piece", { TextColor3 = col.dim, Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 30), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = pickRow
		Theme.chips(opts, state.adjustPiece or "*all", function(k)
			state.adjustPiece = k ~= "*all" and k or nil
			-- the barrel: look through it the way a gunner does in game
			if skin.slot == "Cannon" and k ~= "*all" and Slots.socketFor(Slots.SHIP.Cannon, k) == "Aim" then
				Preview.focusGunner(state.previewItem)
			end
		end, { LayoutOrder = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, -108, 0, 0) }).Parent = pickRow
		pickRow.Parent = parent
	end
	local function shift(t, label)
		local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsTurn", label .. " " .. skin.key)
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			for _, p in ipairs(chosen()) do Preview.setPivot(p, p.PivotOffset * t:Inverse()) end
		end)
		if rec then
			ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, ok and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel)
		end
		if not ok then toast("Could not " .. label:lower() .. " it: " .. tostring(err), "bad") end
		return ok
	end
	local function axisRow(label, order, make)
		local r = Theme.row(6, order, 30)
		T(label, { TextColor3 = col.dim, Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = r
		for i, ax in ipairs({ "X", "Y", "Z" }) do
			Theme.button(ax .. " −", "secondary", function() make(ax, -1) end, { LayoutOrder = i * 2 - 1, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = r
			Theme.button(ax .. " +", "secondary", function() make(ax, 1) end, { LayoutOrder = i * 2, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = r
		end
		r.Parent = parent
	end
	state.moveStep = state.moveStep or 0.05
	state.rotStep = state.rotStep or 5
	local steps = Theme.row(8, 6, 30)
	T("Step", { TextColor3 = col.dim, Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = steps
	Theme.segmented({ { 0.01, "0.01" }, { 0.05, "0.05" }, { 0.25, "0.25" }, { 1, "1 st" } }, state.moveStep,
		function(v) state.moveStep = v end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = steps
	Theme.segmented({ { 1, "1°" }, { 5, "5°" }, { 15, "15°" }, { 90, "90°" } }, state.rotStep,
		function(v) state.rotStep = v end, { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = steps
	steps.Parent = parent
	axisRow("Move", 7, function(ax, s)
		shift(CFrame.new(Vector3.FromAxis(Enum.Axis[ax]) * s * state.moveStep), "Move")
	end)
	axisRow("Rotate", 8, function(ax, s)
		shift(CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.FromAxis(Enum.Axis[ax]), math.rad(state.rotStep) * s), "Rotate")
	end)
	local turnRow = Theme.row(6, 9, 30)
	T("Turn 180°", { TextColor3 = col.dim, Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = turnRow
	for i, ax in ipairs({ "X", "Y", "Z" }) do
		Theme.button("On " .. ax, "secondary", function()
			if shift(CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.FromAxis(Enum.Axis[ax]), math.pi), "Turn") then
				toast("Turned " .. skin.key .. " 180° on " .. ax .. " (its pivot, in the Assets model). Wrong axis? Press it again to undo, then try another.", "ok")
			end
		end, { LayoutOrder = i, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = turnRow
	end
	turnRow.Parent = parent
	-- SCALE every piece about its own pivot (pieces sharing a pivot scale as one)
	state.scaleStep = state.scaleStep or 0.02
	local function scaleAll(factor)
		local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsTurn", "Scale " .. skin.key)
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			for _, p in ipairs(chosen()) do Preview.scale(p, factor) end
		end)
		if rec then
			ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, ok and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel)
		end
		if not ok then toast("Could not scale it: " .. tostring(err), "bad") end
	end
	local sr = Theme.row(6, 10, 30)
	T("Scale", { TextColor3 = col.dim, Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = sr
	Theme.button("Smaller", "secondary", function() scaleAll(1 / (1 + state.scaleStep)) end, { LayoutOrder = 1, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = sr
	Theme.button("Bigger", "secondary", function() scaleAll(1 + state.scaleStep) end, { LayoutOrder = 2, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = sr
	Theme.segmented({ { 0.01, "1%" }, { 0.02, "2%" }, { 0.05, "5%" }, { 0.1, "10%" } }, state.scaleStep,
		function(v) state.scaleStep = v end, { LayoutOrder = 3 }).Parent = sr
	sr.Parent = parent
end

local function showPreview(skin, r)
	if skin.kind ~= "ship" then return end
	if not (state.draft and state.draft.model == skin.model) then
		draftEnd()
		state.draft = { model = skin.model, key = skin.key, snap = snapshotOf(skin.model), dirty = false }
	end
	-- a clean ship: only this skin, defaults in every other slot. Without this, pieces left by
	-- an earlier preview (another theme's set from the Preview tab) stayed on the other slots.
	Preview.stopLive()
	Preview.clearAll()
	local ok, why = Preview.show(skin, r.plan)
	if not ok then
		toast("Preview: " .. tostring(why), "bad")
		return
	end
	paintBody(skin)
	state.previewing = skin
	Preview.watch({ skin.model }, function()
		if state.previewing ~= skin or not skin.model.Parent then return end
		if not draftMuted and state.draft and state.draft.model == skin.model then state.draft.dirty = true end
		local nr = inspectOne(skin)
		Preview.show(skin, nr.plan)
		-- not mid-drag: re-rendering would destroy the colour slider under the mouse
		if state.selected == skin and not Theme.dragging() then renderDetail() end
	end)
end

local function stopPreview()
	draftEnd()
	Preview.stopLive()
	Preview.clearAll()
	state.previewing = nil
end

renderDetail = function()
	if state.mode == "body" then return renderBodyDetail() end
	if state.mode == "preview" then return PreviewTab.renderDetail() end
	if state.mode == "import" then return ImportTab.renderDetail() end
	local d = ui.detail
	for _, c in ipairs(d:GetChildren()) do
		if not (c:IsA("UIListLayout") or c:IsA("UIPadding")) then c:Destroy() end
	end
	local skin = state.selected
	if not skin then
		local empty = Theme.card(nil, 1)
		T("Pick a skin on the left — or select its model in the Explorer.", { FontFace = Theme.fontMedium, TextSize = 16, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = empty
		T("Every skin is checked for its type. Preview shows it on the ship exactly where the game puts it; Setup adds a face, light or name text; Tier changes the website and the game price; Approve adds it to the shop Packages.",
			{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = empty
		empty.Parent = d
		return
	end
	local r = state.results[skin] or inspectOne(skin)
	local web = Website.get(skin.key, skin.slot)
	local tier = tierOf(skin, r)
	local isShip = skin.kind == "ship"

	-- HERO
	local hero = Theme.card(nil, 1)
	local top = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 112), LayoutOrder = 1 })
	thumbnail(skin.model).Parent = top
	local info = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(128, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -128, 1, 0) }, { Theme.vlist(6) })
	T(skin.key, { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 22, LayoutOrder = 1, TextWrapped = false, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, Size = UDim2.new(1, -96, 0, 28) }).Parent = info -- room for the Guide button
	local tags = ShipSkins.themeTags(skin.model)
	local shownTheme = themeOf(skin)
	local themeText = shownTheme and ("  ·  theme " .. shownTheme) or ""
	if isShip and shownTheme and not table.find(tags, shownTheme) then
		themeText ..= #tags > 0 and ("  (tagged " .. table.concat(tags, ", ") .. ")") or "  (no tag)"
	end
	T(skin.slot .. (isShip and "  ·  ship skin" or "  ·  tool skin") .. themeText,
		{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = info
	local pills = Theme.row(6, 3, 22)
	Theme.pill(STATE_LABEL[r.status], STATE_COLOR[r.status], { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = pills
	if tier and Theme.TIER[tier] then Theme.pill(tier:upper(), Theme.TIER[tier], { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = pills end
	if web == false then
		Theme.pill("NOT ON WEBSITE", col.warn, { LayoutOrder = 3 }).Parent = pills
	elseif web then
		Theme.pill(web.status == "approved" and "WEBSITE APPROVED" or ("WEBSITE " .. tostring(web.status):upper()),
			web.status == "approved" and col.ok or col.warn, { LayoutOrder = 3 }).Parent = pills
		if web.exclusive then Theme.pill("EXCLUSIVE", Theme.TIER.Legendary, { LayoutOrder = 4 }).Parent = pills end
	end
	pills.Parent = info
	local actions = Theme.row(8, 4, 32)
	if isShip then
		Theme.button(state.previewing == skin and "Refresh preview" or "Preview on ship", "secondary", function()
			showPreview(skin, r)
			state.previewItem = 1
			Preview.focus(skin.slot, 1)
			renderDetail()
		end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = actions
	end
	Theme.button("Select", "ghost", function() Selection:Set({ skin.model }) end, { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = actions
	local owner = Review.isOwner()
	local pending = Review.get(skin.model)
	local ab, aapi
	if owner then
		local approveText = r.status == "new" and "Approve — add to shop" or (r.status == "changed" and "Approve — update shop"
			or (pending and "Mark reviewed ✓" or "Approved ✓"))
		ab, aapi = Theme.button(approveText, "primary", function()
			if state.busy then return end
			state.busy = true
			toast("Writing " .. skin.key .. " into the shop…")
			draftApply() -- approving takes what is on the ship
			local ok, msg = module().approve(skin, r)
			state.busy = false
			if ok then
				draftQuiet(function() Review.clear(skin.model) end)
				draftForgetReview(skin.model)
			end
			toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "bad")
			if ok then refreshSkin(skin) end
		end, { LayoutOrder = 3 })
		aapi.setEnabled(r.ok and (r.status ~= "same" or pending ~= nil))
	else
		-- DESIGNER: the shop is the owner's; ask for it
		local dirty = state.draft and state.draft.model == skin.model and state.draft.dirty
		ab, aapi = Theme.button(pending and "Sent for review ✓" or (dirty and "Apply & send for review" or "Send for review"), "primary", function()
			local ok = draftQuiet(function() return Review.mark(skin.model, state.reviewNote or "") end)
			-- sending takes the changes shown on the ship (and the review mark) as applied
			if state.draft and state.draft.model == skin.model then
				state.draft.dirty = true
				draftApply()
			end
			state.reviewNote = nil
			toast(ok and (skin.key .. " sent to the owner for review.") or "Could not mark it.", ok and "ok" or "bad")
			refreshSkin(skin)
		end, { LayoutOrder = 3 })
		aapi.setEnabled(r.ok and pending == nil)
	end
	ab.Parent = actions
	actions.Parent = info
	info.Parent = top
	-- GUIDE: how a skin of this category is built (names, pivots, its traps), top right
	Theme.button(state.guideOpen and "Guide ✕" or "ⓘ Guide", state.guideOpen and "primary" or "ghost", function()
		state.guideOpen = not state.guideOpen
		renderDetail()
	end, { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), TextSize = 12 }).Parent = top
	top.Parent = hero
	-- IMPORT REVIEW: a fresh import is checked on its slot's default before it takes its grid cell
	if isShip and skin.model:GetAttribute(Importer.REVIEW_ATTR) then
		local posed = skin.model:GetAttribute(Importer.POSED_ATTR) == true
		local box = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = col.accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.88, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = 3,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y },
			{ Theme.corner(8), Theme.stroke(col.accent, 1), Theme.pad(10, 12, 10, 12), Theme.vlist(8) })
		T("IMPORT REVIEW", { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = col.accent, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = box
		T(posed and "On the default (faded). Fix it here — pick a piece, move / turn / scale it; wrong piece names: Setup → Name the pieces — then Confirm."
			or "Imported, not checked yet. Put it on the default to compare it with the stock piece.", { TextColor3 = col.text, TextSize = 13, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = box
		if posed then
			-- PIECE NAMES: every piece, so a wrong guess can be swapped; it is re-mounted on the default
			local def = Slots.SHIP[skin.slot]
			if def and def.sockets and #def.sockets > 1 then
				local opts = {}
				for _, sock in ipairs(def.sockets) do table.insert(opts, { sock, sock }) end
				local i = 0
				for _, part in ipairs(skin.model:GetChildren()) do
					if part:IsA("BasePart") then
						i += 1
						local row = Theme.row(6, 1 + i)
						T(part.Name, { Size = UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 30), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
							TextWrapped = false, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = row
						Theme.button("Show", "ghost", function() Selection:Set({ part }) end, { LayoutOrder = 1, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = row
						Theme.chips(opts, Slots.socketFor(def, part.Name), function(sock)
							local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsImport", "Name piece " .. sock)
							if part.Parent then part.Name = sock end
							if rec then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit) end
							Importer.startReview(skin.model, skin.slot) -- re-mount by the new names
							refreshSkin(skin)
						end, { LayoutOrder = 2, Size = UDim2.new(1, -210, 0, 0) }).Parent = row
						row.Parent = box
					end
				end
			end
			local holder = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 15, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y },
				{ Theme.vlist(8) })
			adjustRows(skin, holder)
			holder.Parent = box
		end
		local rr = Theme.row(8, 20, 32)
		Theme.button(posed and "Back to the default view" or "Check it on the default", posed and "secondary" or "primary", function()
			local ok, msg = Importer.startReview(skin.model, skin.slot)
			toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "warn")
			refreshSkin(skin)
		end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = rr
		local cb = Theme.button("✓  Confirm — put it in its place", "ok", function()
			-- the grid's tiers come from the website: load its list when the Import tab has not yet
			if not ImportTab.rows() then ImportTab.load() end
			local ok, msg = Importer.finishReview(skin.model, skin.slot, ImportTab.rows())
			toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "bad")
			refreshSkin(skin)
		end, { LayoutOrder = 2 })
		cb.Parent = rr
		rr.Parent = box
		box.Parent = hero
	end
	if state.guideOpen then
		local g = Guide.forSkin(skin)
		local box = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = col.raised, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = 4,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y },
			{ Theme.corner(8), Theme.pad(10, 12, 10, 12), Theme.vlist(6) })
		T(g.title, { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 15, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = box
		local order = 1
		for _, s in ipairs(g.sections) do
			if #s.lines > 0 then
				T(s.heading:upper(), { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = order }).Parent = box
				order += 1
				for _, line in ipairs(s.lines) do
					T("•  " .. line, { TextSize = 13, LayoutOrder = order }).Parent = box
					order += 1
				end
			end
		end
		box.Parent = hero
	end
	hero.Parent = d

	-- READINESS
	local bad, warn = {}, 0
	for _, c in ipairs(r.checks) do
		if c.level == "bad" then table.insert(bad, c.text) elseif c.level == "warn" then warn += 1 end
	end
	local lvl = #bad > 0 and "bad" or (warn > 0 and "warn" or "ok")
	local headline = #bad > 0 and (#bad == 1 and "1 thing to fix before it can go in the shop" or (#bad .. " things to fix before it can go in the shop"))
		or (r.status == "same" and "In the shop and up to date" or (warn > 0 and ("Ready for the shop — " .. warn .. " note" .. (warn > 1 and "s" or "") .. " below") or "Ready for the shop"))
	if web == false and #bad == 0 then headline ..= "  ·  hidden until the website sells it" end
	local banner = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = col[lvl], BackgroundTransparency = 0.86, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 2 },
		{ Theme.corner(8), Theme.stroke(col[lvl], 1), Theme.pad(10, 14, 10, 14), Theme.vlist(4) })
	banner:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke").Transparency = 0.5
	T(headline, { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = col[lvl], LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = banner
	for i, b in ipairs(bad) do
		if i <= 3 then T("•  " .. b, { TextSize = 13, LayoutOrder = 1 + i }).Parent = banner end
	end
	banner.Parent = d

	-- REVIEW
	if pending or not owner then
		local rc = Theme.card(owner and "Review requested" or "Review", 2.5)
		if pending then
			T(Review.text(pending), { FontFace = Theme.fontMedium, TextColor3 = col.warn, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = rc
			Theme.button(owner and "Clear the request" or "Withdraw", "ghost", function()
				draftQuiet(function() Review.clear(skin.model) end)
				draftForgetReview(skin.model)
				refreshSkin(skin)
			end, { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = rc
		else
			T("Designer mode: adjust, preview and set up freely — the owner approves what goes live. Add a note, then Send for review.",
				{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = rc
			local box = Theme.input("Note for the owner (optional) — what changed, what to check", state.reviewNote or "", { LayoutOrder = 2 })
			box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function() state.reviewNote = box.Text end)
			box.Parent = rc
		end
		rc.Parent = d
	end

	-- PREVIEW
	if isShip and state.previewing == skin then
		local pc = Theme.card("Previewing on the ship", 3)
		T("Shown on " .. Preview.SHIP_NAME .. " exactly where the game mounts it. Move a piece, change its pivot, face, light or text in the model — the ship updates at once. Changes wait for Apply (top); Revert or Stop preview puts the model back as it was.",
			{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = pc
		local pr = Theme.row(8, 2) -- wraps: the view buttons join it
		pr:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout").Wraps = true
		Theme.button("Next " .. skin.slot:lower(), "secondary", function()
			state.previewItem += 1
			Preview.focus(skin.slot, state.previewItem)
		end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = pr
		Theme.button("Whole ship", "secondary", function() Preview.focusShip() end, { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = pr
		local theme = themeOf(skin)
		if theme then
			Theme.button("Whole theme: " .. theme, "secondary", function()
				draftEnd() -- the theme view replaces this skin's preview: unapplied changes go back
				-- start clean too: a slot this theme has no skin for shows the default, not a leftover
				Preview.stopLive()
				Preview.clearAll()
				state.previewing = nil
				local n = 0
				for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do
					if s.kind == "ship" and ShipSkins.inTheme(s, theme) then
						local sr = state.results[s] or inspectOne(s)
						if sr.plan and Preview.show(s, sr.plan) then n += 1 end
					end
				end
				paintBody(skin)
				Preview.focusShip()
				toast("Showing " .. n .. " " .. theme .. " skins on the ship. " .. (state.paintSource or ""), "ok")
				renderDetail()
			end, { LayoutOrder = 3 }).Parent = pr
		end
		Theme.button("Stop preview", "ghost", function()
			stopPreview()
			renderDetail()
		end, { LayoutOrder = 4 }).Parent = pr
		-- the slot's FIRST VIEW: frame it once the way you like it; every preview of this slot opens there
		if not Slots.SHIP[skin.slot].texture then
			Theme.button("Use this view first", "ghost", function()
				local ok, why = Preview.saveView(skin.slot)
				toast(ok and ("Saved: previews of a " .. skin.slot:lower() .. " open on this view (" .. tostring(why) .. ").") or why, ok and "ok" or "bad")
				renderDetail()
			end, { LayoutOrder = 5 }).Parent = pr
			if Preview.savedView(skin.slot) then
				Theme.button("Forget view", "ghost", function()
					Preview.forgetView(skin.slot)
					toast("Previews of a " .. skin.slot:lower() .. " frame it automatically again.", "ok")
					renderDetail()
				end, { LayoutOrder = 6 }).Parent = pr
			end
		end
		pr.Parent = pc
		local bodyRow = Theme.row(10, 3, 32)
		T("Body colours", { TextColor3 = col.dim, Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = bodyRow
		Theme.segmented({ { "theme", "Theme colours" }, { "default", "Default" } }, state.bodyPaint == false and "default" or "theme", function(k)
			state.bodyPaint = k == "theme"
			paintBody(skin)
			renderDetail()
		end, { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = bodyRow
		bodyRow.Parent = pc
		if state.paintSource then
			T(state.paintSource, { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 4 }).Parent = pc
		end
		-- a piece mounted the wrong way round: turn its PIVOT (the row's pivot is the piece's
		-- PivotOffset verbatim), so Approve carries the fix — no offset kept anywhere else.
		-- Move / rotate / turn act on every piece, each on its own socket (t is in socket space:
		-- moving the mounted piece by t = pivot P becomes P * t⁻¹); the live preview re-shows it.
		-- One piece at a time: Preview tab → Adjust.
		if not Slots.SHIP[skin.slot].texture then
			adjustRows(skin, pc)
			changesStrip(skin, 11).Parent = pc
			T("Moves the pivot in the Assets model, so Approve takes it to the shop. Piece: All moves every piece on its own socket, or pick one. Ctrl+Z undoes a click.",
				{ TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 12 }).Parent = pc
		end
		pc.Parent = d
	end

	-- SETUP
	local st = isShip and Setup.status(skin)
	local unnamed = isShip and Importer.unnamedPieces(skin.model, skin.slot) or {}
	if st or #unnamed > 0 then
		local sc = Theme.card("Setup", 4)
		-- NAME THE PIECES first: nothing mounts until each piece carries its socket's name
		if #unnamed > 0 then
			local def = Slots.SHIP[skin.slot]
			T(("Name the pieces: %d not named after a socket. Show picks it in Studio; click the socket it is."):format(#unnamed),
				{ FontFace = Theme.fontMedium, TextColor3 = col.warn, LayoutOrder = -40 }).Parent = sc
			local gr = Theme.row(8, -39, 30)
			Theme.button("Guess names", "primary", function()
				local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsSetup", "Guess piece names " .. skin.key)
				local okG, n, donorName = pcall(Importer.applyGuess, skin.model, skin.slot)
				if rec then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, okG and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel) end
				if not okG then toast("Could not guess: " .. tostring(n), "bad")
				elseif (n or 0) == 0 then toast("No skin of this slot to guess from — name them by hand.", "warn")
				else toast(("Named %d piece(s) like %s — check them on the ship."):format(n, tostring(donorName)), "ok") end
				refreshSkin(skin)
			end, { LayoutOrder = 1, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = gr
			T("from the closest skin of this slot, by shape and place", { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = gr
			gr.Parent = sc
			for i, part in ipairs(unnamed) do
				local row = Theme.row(6, -38 + i)
				T(part.Name, { Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 30), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
					TextWrapped = false, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = row
				Theme.button("Show", "ghost", function() Selection:Set({ part }) end, { LayoutOrder = 1, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = row
				local opts = {}
				for _, sock in ipairs(def.sockets) do table.insert(opts, { sock, sock }) end
				Theme.chips(opts, nil, function(sock)
					local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsSetup", "Name piece " .. sock)
					if part.Parent then part.Name = sock end
					if rec then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit) end
					refreshSkin(skin)
				end, { LayoutOrder = 2, Size = UDim2.new(1, -230, 0, 0) }).Parent = row
				row.Parent = sc
			end
		end
		if not st then
			-- only the piece names to set up
		elseif st.kind == "face" then
			T(st.has and "This wheel has Billy's face. Move, turn, size or recolour it below." or
				"This wheel has no face yet. Billy needs one on every wheel skin.", { LayoutOrder = 1, TextColor3 = st.has and col.dim or col.text }).Parent = sc
			local same = Setup.faceDonor(skin.model)
			local sr = Theme.row(8, 2, 32)
			-- only when there is no face: "Replace face" threw a tuned face away on one mis-click
			if not st.has then
				Theme.button("Add face", "primary", function()
					local ok, msg = Setup.addFace(skin.model)
					toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "bad")
					refreshSkin(skin)
					if state.previewing == skin then showPreview(skin, state.results[skin]) end
				end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = sr
			end
			if same then T("A wheel with the same hub exists (" .. same.model.Name .. ") — the face goes exactly where it has it.",
				{ TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 2, Size = UDim2.new(1, -140, 0, 0) }).Parent = sr end
			sr.Parent = sc
			-- FACE TUNING: pick the whole face, a group or a free part; move / turn it in the hub's
			-- frame; size the whole face; recolour any part. Live on the ship, one undo step a click.
			-- HUB: the wheel turns about its RotationPart's PIVOT (the stand's SpinMotor turns the socket
			-- about its Z through its origin). The wheel's middle off that axis = a wobble.
			local wheelPiece = skin.model:FindFirstChild("RotationPart")
			if wheelPiece and wheelPiece:IsA("BasePart") then
				local M = wheelPiece.PivotOffset:Inverse() -- the piece in its socket's frame
				local off = Vector2.new(M.X, M.Y).Magnitude
				local hr = Theme.row(8, -20, 30)
				T("Hub", { TextColor3 = col.dim, Size = UDim2.new(0, 70, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = hr
				T(("box centre %.2f studs off the turning axis"):format(off), { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = hr
				Theme.button("Centre box on axis", "secondary", function()
					-- keep the depth along the axis (Z), put the middle on it (X, Y = 0 in the socket's frame)
					local Mi = wheelPiece.PivotOffset:Inverse()
					local newPivot = (CFrame.new(-Mi.X, -Mi.Y, 0) * Mi):Inverse()
					local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsSetup", "Centre wheel on hub " .. skin.key)

-- BODY COLOURS ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- One row per theme (a skin theme tag, a catalogue set, or a colour ship's tag). The editor
-- tunes the six paint groups with sliders / RGB / swatches, repaints the preview ship live,
-- creates or updates the theme's colour ship in workspace.ship, and Approve writes the
-- theme's BODY_COLORS entry into SkinCatalog.

state.drafts = {} -- [theme] = { [group] = Color3 } being edited
state.bodyGroup = "Hull"

local function bodyThemes()
	local cat = ShipSkins.catalogData()
	local set = {}
	for _, s in ipairs(ShipSkins.scan()) do
		local t = ShipSkins.themeOf(s)
		if t then set[t] = true end
	end
	for k in pairs(cat and cat.BodyPackage or {}) do
		if k ~= "Default" then set[k] = true end
	end
	local folder = Paint.donorFolder()
	for _, m in ipairs(folder and folder:GetChildren() or {}) do
		for _, t in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTags(m)) do
			if t:sub(1, 12) ~= "SkinSurface_" then set[t] = true end
		end
	end
	local list = {}
	for t in pairs(set) do table.insert(list, { kind = "body", key = t, slot = "Body" }) end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.key:lower() < b.key:lower() end)
	return list
end

-- what the shop and the colour ship hold for a theme right now
local function bodySources(theme)
	local cat = ShipSkins.catalogData()
	local shop = Paint.fromCatalog(cat, theme)
	local donor = Paint.findDonor(theme)
	local donorPalette = donor and Paint.read(donor) or nil
	return shop, donor, donorPalette, Paint.isStyle(cat, theme)
end

-- what the theme HAS (APPLIED, 2026-10-02): its colour ship — where Apply writes — else the
-- shop's set, else the default; per group, so a colour ship without a mast takes the mast from
-- the shop / default. Revert goes back to this; Approve sends it to the shop.
local function baselineFor(theme)
	local shop, _, donorPalette = bodySources(theme)
	local base = Paint.defaults(ShipSkins.catalogData())
	local d = {}
	for _, g in ipairs(Paint.GROUPS) do d[g] = (donorPalette and donorPalette[g]) or (shop and shop[g]) end
	-- the shop's own fallbacks (SkinCatalog's BODY_COLORS loop): steps follow the mast, stairs the hull
	d.MastSteps = d.MastSteps or d.Mast
	d.Stairs = d.Stairs or d.Hull
	for _, g in ipairs(Paint.GROUPS) do d[g] = d[g] or base[g] end
	return d
end

-- the colours being tuned (kept per theme while the plugin is open)
local function draftFor(theme)
	if not state.drafts[theme] then state.drafts[theme] = baselineFor(theme) end
	return state.drafts[theme]
end

-- APPLY: the draft onto the theme's colour ship (made when it has none) and the grid's Body row,
-- one undo step; a designer's Apply also sends it to the owner for review — answers ok, message
local function bodyApply(theme, draft)
	local _, donor = bodySources(theme)
	local ship = donor
	local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsColourShip", "Apply colours of " .. theme)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		if ship then
			Paint.apply(ship, draft)
		else
			local made, why = Paint.createDonor(theme, draft)
			if not made then error(why) end
			ship = made
		end
		Importer.redressBodies() -- the grid's display copies / masts follow; a new ship replaces its display one
	end)
	if rec then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, ok and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel) end
	if not ok then return false, "Could not apply: " .. tostring(err) end
	if not Review.isOwner() then
		Review.mark(ship, "body colours for " .. theme)
		return true, theme .. " colours applied on workspace.ship." .. ship.Name .. " and sent to the owner for review."
	end
	return true, theme .. " colours applied on workspace.ship." .. ship.Name .. (donor and "" or " (new)") .. " — Approve puts them in the shop. Save the place."
end

local pendingPaint = false
local function repaintLive(theme)
	if state.bodyPreview ~= theme or pendingPaint then return end
	pendingPaint = true
	task.defer(function()
		pendingPaint = false
		if state.bodyPreview == theme and Preview.exists() then Preview.paint(draftFor(theme)) end
	end)
end

local function previewTheme(theme)
	-- start clean, like the Whole theme button: a slot this theme has no skin for shows the
	-- ship's default, not the last theme's leftover (JollyRoger wore DiscoOcto's door)
	draftEnd()
	Preview.stopLive()
	Preview.clearAll()
	local n = 0
	for _, s in ipairs(ShipSkins.scan()) do
		if ShipSkins.inTheme(s, theme) then
			local r = ShipSkins.inspect(s, Website.get(s.key, s.slot) or nil)
			if r.plan and Preview.show(s, r.plan) then n += 1 end
		end
	end
	local cat = ShipSkins.catalogData()
	-- a texture-style body has no colour draft: show the style itself
	Preview.paint(Paint.isStyle(cat, theme) and (Preview.paletteFor(theme, cat)) or draftFor(theme))
	state.bodyPreview = theme
	state.previewing = nil
	Preview.focusShip()
	return n
end

	local bodyPending = donor and Review.get(donor)
	if Review.isOwner() then
		local ab, aapi = Theme.button(dirty and "Approve — apply first" or shop and (matchesShop and "In the shop ✓" or "Approve — update shop") or "Approve — add to shop", "primary", function()
			local ok, msg = Paint.approve(theme, draft, ShipSkins.catalogModule(), ShipSkins.catalogData())
			if ok and donor then Review.clear(donor) end
			toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "bad")
			local cat = ShipSkins.catalogData(true)
			renderBodyList()
			renderBodyDetail()
			-- ROBUX (website 1.110): the whole set's Developer Product, so the Shipyard's Robux
			-- button works — made once per theme; the website picks the price from the tier
			if ok then
				local row = cat and cat.BodyPackage and cat.BodyPackage[theme]
				task.spawn(function()
					local okP, said = Website.ensureBodyProduct(theme, row and row.tier, { Hull = draft.Hull, Rim = draft.Rim })
					toast(said, okP and "ok" or "warn")
				end)
			end
		end, { LayoutOrder = 3 })
		aapi.setEnabled(not styled and not dirty and (not matchesShop or bodyPending ~= nil))
		ab.Parent = actions
	elseif bodyPending then
		Theme.pill("SENT FOR REVIEW", col.accent, { LayoutOrder = 4 }).Parent = pills
	end
	actions.Parent = hero
	hero.Parent = d

	-- STATUS
	local lvl, head = "info", ""
	if styled then
		lvl, head = "warn", theme .. " is a texture style (per-part textures) — its body is not a colour set, so it is not edited here."
	elseif dirty then
		lvl, head = "warn", "Changed, not applied — Apply puts them on the colour ship" .. (Review.isOwner() and "" or " and sends them for review") .. "; Revert takes them back."
	elseif shop and matchesShop then
		lvl, head = "ok", "These colours are in the shop."
	elseif not Review.isOwner() then
		lvl, head = "info", bodyPending and "Applied and sent — the owner checks them and puts them in the shop." or "Tune the colours, then Apply — it sends them to the owner for review."
	elseif shop then
		lvl, head = "warn", "Applied on the colour ship — Approve to update the shop (then Publish SkinCatalog)."
	else
		lvl, head = "info", "Not in the shop yet. Tune, Apply, then Approve. Approve puts it on sale for gold once SkinCatalog is published, and makes the whole set's Robux product on the website."
	end
	local banner = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = col[lvl], BackgroundTransparency = 0.86, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 2 },
		{ Theme.corner(8), Theme.stroke(col[lvl], 1), Theme.pad(10, 14, 10, 14), Theme.vlist(4) })
	banner:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke").Transparency = 0.5
	T(head, { FontFace = Theme.fontMedium, TextColor3 = col[lvl] == col.info and col.text or col[lvl], LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = banner
	banner.Parent = d
	if styled then return end

	-- EDITOR
	local ed = Theme.card("Colours", 3)
	local rows = {}
	local sliders = {}
	local function paintChip(g)
		local c = draft[g]
		if chips[g] then chips[g].BackgroundColor3 = c end
		if rows[g] then
			rows[g].swatch.BackgroundColor3 = c
			if not rows[g].box:IsFocused() then rows[g].box.Text = Theme.rgb(c) .. "   " .. Theme.hex(c) end
		end
	end
	local function syncSliders()
		local c = draft[state.bodyGroup]
		local h, s, v = c:ToHSV()
		if sliders.h then
			sliders.h.set(h)
			sliders.s.set(s)
			sliders.v.set(v)
			sliders.s.grad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromHSV(h, 0, v), Color3.fromHSV(h, 1, math.max(v, 0.05)))
			sliders.v.grad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Color3.fromHSV(h, s, 1))
		end
	end
	-- UNDO: the draft is not an instance, so Studio's Ctrl+Z never sees it. Each change keeps
	-- the colour it replaced; a slider drag (changes to one part less than a second apart) is
	-- ONE step. Apply and Revert start the history afresh.
	state.bodyHistory = state.bodyHistory or {}
	local hist = state.bodyHistory[theme] or {}
	state.bodyHistory[theme] = hist
	local refreshUndo = function() end -- set once the Undo button exists
	local function setColor(g, c, noHistory)
		if draft[g] == c then return end
		if not noHistory then
			local top = hist[#hist]
			if top and top.g == g and os.clock() - top.t < 1 then
				top.t = os.clock() -- the same drag: keep the colour from before it began
			else
				table.insert(hist, { g = g, c = draft[g], t = os.clock() })
				if #hist > 100 then table.remove(hist, 1) end
			end
		end
		draft[g] = c
		paintChip(g)
		if g == state.bodyGroup then syncSliders() end
		repaintLive(theme)
		refreshUndo()
	end
	-- the colour a part has APPLIED (on the colour ship, else the shop's, else default)
	local function savedColor(part) return applied[part] end
	for i, g in ipairs(Paint.GROUPS) do
		local sel = g == state.bodyGroup
		local row = new("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = i,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36), BackgroundColor3 = sel and col.selected or col.card, BackgroundTransparency = sel and 0 or 1 },
			{ Theme.corner(6) })
		local sw = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, -12), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24), BackgroundColor3 = draft[g], BorderSizePixel = 0 },
			{ Theme.corner(6), Theme.stroke(col.cardStroke) })
		sw.Parent = row
		T(Paint.LABEL[g], { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 110, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
			FontFace = sel and Theme.fontMedium or Theme.font }).Parent = row
		local box = Theme.input("r, g, b  or  #hex", Theme.rgb(draft[g]) .. "   " .. Theme.hex(draft[g]),
			{ Position = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0.5, -14), Size = UDim2.new(1, -170, 0, 28), FontFace = Theme.fontMono, TextSize = 13 })
		box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			local c = Theme.parseColor(box.Text:match("#%x+") or box.Text:gsub("%s+#%x+$", ""))
			if c then setColor(g, c) else box.Text = Theme.rgb(draft[g]) .. "   " .. Theme.hex(draft[g]) end
		end)
		box.Parent = row
		row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			state.bodyGroup = g
			renderBodyDetail()
		end)
		rows[g] = { swatch = sw, box = box }
		row.Parent = ed
	end
	-- sliders for the selected group
	local g = state.bodyGroup
	T("Tuning " .. Paint.LABEL[g], { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 13, LayoutOrder = 10 }).Parent = ed
	local h0, s0, v0 = draft[g]:ToHSV()
	local hueKeys = {}
	for i = 0, 6 do table.insert(hueKeys, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(i / 6, Color3.fromHSV(i / 6 % 1, 1, 1))) end
	local cur = { h = h0, s = s0, v = v0 }
	local function fromSliders()
		setColor(g, Color3.fromHSV(cur.h, cur.s, cur.v))
	end
	local hf, hset = Theme.slider("Hue", h0, ColorSequence.new(hueKeys), function(x) cur.h = x fromSliders() end, 11)
	local sf, sset, sgrad = Theme.slider("Saturation", s0, ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(1, 1, 1)), function(x) cur.s = x fromSliders() end, 12)
	local vf, vset, vgrad = Theme.slider("Brightness", v0, ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(1, 1, 1)), function(x) cur.v = x fromSliders() end, 13)
	sliders.h = { set = hset }
	sliders.s = { set = sset, grad = sgrad }
	sliders.v = { set = vset, grad = vgrad }
	hf.Parent, sf.Parent, vf.Parent = ed, ed, ed
	syncSliders()
	Theme.swatches(Theme.SWATCHES, draft[g], function(c)
		local h, s, v = c:ToHSV()
		cur.h, cur.s, cur.v = h, s, v
		setColor(g, c)
	end, 14).Parent = ed
	local quick = Theme.row(8, 15, 30)
	Theme.button("Stairs = Hull", "ghost", function() setColor("Stairs", draft.Hull) end, { LayoutOrder = 1, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = quick
	Theme.button("Mast steps = Mast", "ghost", function() setColor("MastSteps", draft.Mast) end, { LayoutOrder = 2, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = quick
	quick.Parent = ed
	local undoRow = Theme.row(8, 16, 30)
	local undoB, undoApi = Theme.button(#hist > 0 and ("Undo  (" .. #hist .. ")") or "Undo", "secondary", function()
		local top = table.remove(hist)
		if not top then return end
		if top.all then
			state.drafts[theme] = top.all
		else
			state.bodyGroup = top.g
			setColor(top.g, top.c, true)
		end
		repaintLive(theme)
		renderBodyDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 1, TextSize = 12 })
	undoApi.setEnabled(#hist > 0)
	undoB.Parent = undoRow
	local saved = savedColor(g)
	local putB, putApi = Theme.button("Put back " .. Paint.LABEL[g], "ghost", function()
		setColor(g, saved)
		renderBodyDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 2, TextSize = 12 })
	putApi.setEnabled(saved ~= nil and draft[g] ~= saved)
	putB.Parent = undoRow
	undoRow.Parent = ed
	-- APPLY / REVERT (the skins' strip): Apply puts the colours on the colour ship (a designer's
	-- also goes to the owner for review); Revert takes the draft back to what is applied
	local box = new("Frame", { BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = 17, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46) },
		{ Theme.corner(8), Theme.stroke(col.cardStroke, 1), Theme.pad(8, 10, 8, 10), Theme.hlist(8) })
	local applyB, applyApi = Theme.button(Review.isOwner() and "✓  Apply" or "✓  Apply & send for review", "ok", function()
		local ok, msg = bodyApply(theme, draft)
		if ok then table.clear(hist) end
		toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "bad")
		renderBodyList()
		renderBodyDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 1, TextSize = 13 })
	applyB.Parent = box
	local revertB, revertApi = Theme.button("↺  Revert", "warn", function()
		state.drafts[theme] = baselineFor(theme)
		table.clear(hist)
		repaintLive(theme)
		toast(theme .. " is back to its applied colours.", "ok")
		renderBodyDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 2, TextSize = 13 })
	revertB.Parent = box
	local note = T("", { TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 3, TextWrapped = false, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 1, 0) })
	note.Parent = box
	local function paintStrip()
		local changed = not Paint.same(applied, draft)
		local tone = changed and col.warn or col.cardStroke
		box.BackgroundColor3 = tone
		box.BackgroundTransparency = changed and 0.85 or 0.6
		box:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke").Color = tone
		applyApi.setEnabled(changed or (not donor and not styled))
		revertApi.setEnabled(changed)
		note.Text = changed and "Not applied yet — shown on the preview ship only"
			or (donor and "Applied — the colour ship has these colours" or "No colour ship yet — Apply makes one")
		note.TextColor3 = changed and col.warn or col.dim
	end
	paintStrip()
	box.Parent = ed
	refreshUndo = function()
		undoB.Text = #hist > 0 and ("Undo  (" .. #hist .. ")") or "Undo"
		undoApi.setEnabled(#hist > 0)
		putApi.setEnabled(saved ~= nil and draft[g] ~= saved)
		paintStrip()
	end
	ed.Parent = d

	-- THE THEME'S SKINS
	local sk = Theme.card("Skins in this theme", 4)
	local n = 0
	for _, s in ipairs(ShipSkins.scan()) do
		if ShipSkins.inTheme(s, theme) then
			n += 1
			local b = Theme.button(s.slot .. "  ·  " .. s.key, "ghost", function()
				state.mode = "ship"
				App.selectKey = s.key
				refresh(true)
			end, { LayoutOrder = n, TextSize = 13 })
			b.Parent = sk
		end
	end
	if n == 0 then T("No skin models tagged " .. theme .. ".", { TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = sk end
	sk.Parent = d
end

-- REFRESH -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function refresh(fetchWeb)
	if not state.mode then
		renderList()
		renderDetail()
		toast("Nothing to check here — open the Assets place (ship skins) or PVP&NPC ASSETS (tool skins).", "warn")
		return
	end
	if state.mode == "ship" or state.mode == "body" or state.mode == "preview" then ShipSkins.catalogData(true) end
	if state.mode == "preview" then
		renderList()
		renderDetail()
		toast("Pick a theme to dress the ship with its whole set.")
		return
	end
	if state.mode == "import" then
		renderList()
		renderDetail()
		task.spawn(function()
			ImportTab.load()
			if state.mode == "import" then
				renderList()
				renderDetail()
			end
		end)
		toast("Reading the website's merch…")
		return
	end
	if state.mode == "body" then
		state.skins = bodyThemes()
		if state.selected and not table.find(state.skins, state.selected) then state.selected = nil end
		renderList()
		renderDetail()
		toast(string.format("%d themes. Pick one to tune its body colours.", #state.skins))
		return
	end
	state.skins = module().scan()
	table.clear(state.results)
	for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do inspectOne(s) end
	if state.selected and not table.find(state.skins, state.selected) then state.selected = nil end
	if App.selectKey then -- a jump from another tab ("Skins in this theme")
		for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do
			if s.key == App.selectKey then state.selected = s end
		end
		App.selectKey = nil
	end
	renderList()
	renderDetail()
	toast(string.format("Checked %d skins.", #state.skins))
	if fetchWeb then
		task.spawn(function()
			if not Website.ownerToken() then
				ui.webError = nil
				App.paintWebPill()
				return
			end
			toast("Asking the website about " .. #state.skins .. " skins…")
			local names = {}
			for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do table.insert(names, s.key) end
			local ok, err = Website.fetch(names)
			ui.webError = (not ok) and err or nil
			App.paintWebPill(ok)
			for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do inspectOne(s) end
			renderList()
			renderDetail()
			toast(ok and string.format("%d skins checked against the catalogue and the website.", #state.skins) or err, ok and "ok" or "warn")
		end)
	end
end

function App.paintWebPill(ok)
	if ui.rolePill then
		ui.rolePill.Text = Review.isOwner() and "OWNER" or "DESIGNER"
		ui.rolePill.TextColor3 = Review.isOwner() and col.ok or col.accent
		ui.rolePill.BackgroundColor3 = ui.rolePill.TextColor3
	end
	if not ui.webPill then return end
	state.webOk = ok
	local text
	if not Website.token() then
		text = "Add website token"
		ui.webPill.TextColor3 = col.warn
	elseif not Website.isOwnerToken() then
		text = "Designer token — Import"
		ui.webPill.TextColor3 = col.accent
	elseif ok == false then
		text = "Website unreachable"
		ui.webPill.TextColor3 = col.bad
	else
		text = "Website connected"
		ui.webPill.TextColor3 = col.ok
	end
	-- a narrow dock shows only the dot (fitHeader); the words stay a click away in Settings
	ui.webPill.Text = state.compactHeader and "●" or ("●  " .. text)
end

-- SETTINGS ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function buildSettings(root)
	local s = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = col.bg, Visible = false, ZIndex = 20, BorderSizePixel = 0 })
	local inner = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), ZIndex = 20 }, { Theme.pad(24), Theme.vlist(12) })
	local card = Theme.card(nil, 1, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0) })
	T("Settings", { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 20, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = card
	T("Website token — OWNER: your agent token (team.zaalstudio.com → Dashboard → Agent token). DESIGNER: your own Blender token (Dashboard → Your Blender token); it opens Import once the owner ticks Import into Studio for you. Kept in this plugin's settings on this computer only; never in a place or the repo — never share the owner's agent token.",
		{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = card
	ui.tokenBox = Theme.input("zaal_agent_…", "", { LayoutOrder = 3, FontFace = Theme.fontMono })
	ui.tokenBox.Parent = card
	T("Website address", { TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 4 }).Parent = card
	ui.urlBox = Theme.input("https://team.zaalstudio.com", "", { LayoutOrder = 5, FontFace = Theme.fontMono })
	ui.urlBox.Parent = card
	local row = Theme.row(8, 6, 32)
	Theme.button("Save", "primary", function()
		if ui.tokenBox.Text ~= "" then Website.setToken(ui.tokenBox.Text) end
		Website.setUrl(ui.urlBox.Text)
		s.Visible = false
		refresh(true)
	end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = row
	Theme.button("Forget token", "secondary", function()
		Website.setToken(nil)
		ui.tokenBox.PlaceholderText = "zaal_agent_…"
		App.paintWebPill()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = row
	Theme.button("Close", "ghost", function() s.Visible = false end, { LayoutOrder = 3 }).Parent = row
	row.Parent = card
	local pv = Theme.row(8, 7, 32)
	Theme.button("Remove preview ship", "ghost", function()
		stopPreview()
		Preview.destroy()
		toast("Preview ship removed.", "ok")
	end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = pv
	pv.Parent = card
	card.Parent = inner
	inner.Parent = s
	for _, dsc in ipairs(s:GetDescendants()) do
		if dsc:IsA("GuiObject") then dsc.ZIndex = 21 end
	end
	s.Parent = root
	return s
end

local function openSettings()
	ui.settings.Visible = true
	ui.tokenBox.Text = ""
	ui.tokenBox.PlaceholderText = Website.token() and "A token is saved — paste a new one to replace it" or "zaal_agent_… (owner)  or  your Blender token (designer)"
	ui.urlBox.Text = Website.url()
end

-- BUILD ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function App.mount(widget)
	local root = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = col.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0 })
	Theme.bindDragHost(root) -- slider drags follow the mouse anywhere over the panel
	PreviewTab.init({
		ui = ui,
		toast = function(...) toast(...) end,
		themes = function() return bodyThemes() end,
		query = function() return state.query end,
		active = function() return state.mode == "preview" end,
		-- a set row's skin name opens that skin in the Ship skins tab, to edit it
		openSkin = function(key)
			PreviewTab.leave()
			App.show("ship", key)
		end,
	})
	ImportTab.init({
		ui = ui,
		toast = function(...) toast(...) end,
		query = function() return state.query end,
		active = function() return state.mode == "import" end,
		openSkin = function(key) App.show("ship", key) end,
		-- a fresh import: onto its slot's default, camera there, its review open in Ship skins
		review = function(key, slot)
			local def = slot and Slots.SHIP[slot]
			local folder = def and workspace:FindFirstChild(def.folder)
			local m = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(key)
			if not m then return end
			local ok, msg = Importer.startReview(m, slot)
			App.show("ship", key)
			toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "warn")
		end,
	})

	-- top bar
	local top = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52), BackgroundColor3 = col.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0 },
		{ Theme.pad(10, 12, 10, 14) })
	new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -1), BackgroundColor3 = col.cardStroke, BorderSizePixel = 0 }).Parent = root
	local left = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 1, 0) }, { Theme.hlist(12) })
	new("ImageLabel", { Image = LOGO, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30), LayoutOrder = 0,
		ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit }).Parent = left
	ui.title = T("ZAAL Assets", { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 18, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
		TextWrapped = false, LayoutOrder = 1 })
	ui.title.Parent = left
	ui.rolePill = Theme.pill(Review.isOwner() and "OWNER" or "DESIGNER", Review.isOwner() and col.ok or col.accent, { LayoutOrder = 3 })
	ui.rolePill.Parent = left
	local hasShip, hasTool = ShipSkins.available(), ToolSkins.available()
	state.mode = hasShip and "ship" or (hasTool and "tool" or nil)
	local modes = {}
	if hasShip then
		table.insert(modes, { "ship", "Ship skins" })
		table.insert(modes, { "preview", "Preview" })
		table.insert(modes, { "body", "Body colours" })
		table.insert(modes, { "import", "Import" })
	end
	if hasTool then table.insert(modes, { "tool", "Tool skins" }) end
	if #modes > 1 then
		local seg, paintSeg = Theme.segmented(modes, state.mode, function(k)
			if state.mode == "preview" and k ~= "preview" then PreviewTab.leave() end
			state.mode = k
			state.selected = nil
			refresh(k ~= "body")
		end, { LayoutOrder = 2 })
		seg.Parent = left
		ui.paintMode = paintSeg
	elseif state.mode then
		Theme.pill(state.mode == "ship" and "SHIP SKINS" or "TOOL SKINS", col.accent, { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = left
	end
	left.Parent = top
	local right = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 1, 0) }, { Theme.hlist(8) })
	right:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout").HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
	-- TIME OF DAY for every tab: judge a skin (and a lantern's light) by day and by night. Studio's own
	-- time comes back on "Studio", when the panel closes and when the plugin unloads (a save never keeps the night)
	local lightSeg, paintLight = Theme.segmented({ { "studio", "Studio" }, { "day", "Day" }, { "sunset", "Sunset" }, { "night", "Night" } },
		Preview.lightMode or "studio", function(k)
			if k == "studio" then Preview.restoreLight() else Preview.setLight(k) end
		end, { LayoutOrder = 0 })
	lightSeg.Parent = right
	ui.paintLight = paintLight
	ui.webPill = new("TextButton", { Text = "", FontFace = Theme.fontMedium, TextSize = 13, AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, LayoutOrder = 1 })
	ui.webPill.MouseButton1Click:Connect(openSettings)
	ui.webPill.Parent = right
	Theme.button("Refresh", "secondary", function() Website.clear() refresh(true) end, { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = right
	Theme.button("Settings", "ghost", openSettings, { LayoutOrder = 3 }).Parent = right
	right.Parent = top
	top.Parent = root

	-- NARROW DOCK: the two halves of the bar met in the middle and drew over each other.
	-- First the website status shrinks to its dot, then the title hides (the logo stays).
	-- Decided from the FULL widths, remembered while they were shown.
	local leftL, rightL = left:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout"), right:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
	local full = { title = 0, web = 0 }
	local DOT = 16
	local function fitHeader()
		if ui.title.Visible then full.title = math.max(full.title, ui.title.AbsoluteSize.X) end
		if not state.compactHeader then full.web = math.max(full.web, ui.webPill.AbsoluteSize.X) end
		local need = leftL.AbsoluteContentSize.X + rightL.AbsoluteContentSize.X + 24
		if not ui.title.Visible then need += full.title + 12 end
		if state.compactHeader then need += math.max(full.web - DOT, 0) end
		local room = top.AbsoluteSize.X - 26
		if room <= 0 then return end
		local compact = need > room
		local hideTitle = compact and need - math.max(full.web - DOT, 0) > room
		if compact ~= (state.compactHeader == true) or hideTitle == ui.title.Visible then
			state.compactHeader = compact
			ui.title.Visible = not hideTitle
			App.paintWebPill(state.webOk)
		end
	end
	top:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fitHeader)
	leftL:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(fitHeader)
	rightL:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(fitHeader)
	task.defer(fitHeader)

	-- left column: search, filters, list
	local side = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 52), Size = UDim2.new(0.36, 0, 1, -52 - 30), BackgroundColor3 = col.bg,
		BorderSizePixel = 0 }, { Theme.pad(12, 10, 0, 12) })
	local search = Theme.input("Search skins or slots…", "", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32) })
	search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		state.query = search.Text
		renderList()
	end)
	search.Parent = side
	local filters = new("ScrollingFrame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 40), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 0, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
		ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.X }, { Theme.hlist(6) })
	ui.filterButtons = {}
	for i, key in ipairs({ "all", "review", "new", "changed", "problems" }) do
		local b
		b = Theme.button(key, "secondary", function()
			state.filter = key
			for k, fb in pairs(ui.filterButtons) do
				fb.BackgroundColor3 = k == key and col.selected or col.raised
			end
			renderList()
		end, { LayoutOrder = i, TextSize = 12, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 26) })
		ui.filterButtons[key] = b
		b.Parent = filters
	end
	ui.filterButtons.all.BackgroundColor3 = col.selected
	ui.filters = filters
	filters.Parent = side
	ui.list = new("ScrollingFrame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 78), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -78), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 5, ScrollBarImageColor3 = col.dim, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y }, { Theme.vlist(2) })
	ui.list.Parent = side
	side.Parent = root
	new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0.36, 0, 0, 52), Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, -82), BackgroundColor3 = col.cardStroke, BorderSizePixel = 0 }).Parent = root

	-- right column: detail
	ui.detail = new("ScrollingFrame", { Position = UDim2.new(0.36, 1, 0, 52), Size = UDim2.new(0.64, -1, 1, -52 - 30), BackgroundColor3 = col.panel,
		BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 6, ScrollBarImageColor3 = col.dim, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y }, { Theme.pad(16), Theme.vlist(12) })
	ui.detail.Parent = root

	-- status bar
	local bar = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -30), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BackgroundColor3 = col.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0 })
	new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = col.cardStroke, BorderSizePixel = 0 }).Parent = bar
	ui.statusDot = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.5, -4), BackgroundColor3 = col.info, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, { Theme.corner(4) })
	ui.statusDot.Parent = bar
	ui.status = T("", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
		TextSize = 13, TextWrapped = false, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextColor3 = col.dim })
	ui.status.Parent = bar
	bar.Parent = root

	ui.settings = buildSettings(root)
	root.Parent = widget
	App.paintWebPill()
	if not Website.ownerToken() then toast("Paste your website token in Settings to see approval and change tiers.", "warn") end
end

-- open a tab (and optionally a row by key): "ship" | "body" | "tool"
function App.show(mode, key)
	state.mode = mode
	if ui.paintMode then ui.paintMode(mode) end
	state.selected = nil
	App.selectKey = key
	refresh(mode ~= "body")
	if mode == "body" and key then
		for _, t in ipairs(state.skins) do
			if t.key == key then state.selected = t end
		end
		App.selectKey = nil
		renderList()
		renderDetail()
	end
end

-- the panel follows the Explorer selection while it is open
local selectionConn
function App.setOpen(open)
	if open then
		refresh(true)
		selectionConn = Selection.SelectionChanged:Connect(function()
			local sel = Selection:Get()[1]
			if not sel then return end
			for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do
				if sel == s.model or sel:IsDescendantOf(s.model) then
					if state.selected ~= s then
						state.selected = s
						state.showRow = false
						renderList()
						renderDetail()
					end
					return
				end
			end
		end)
	else
		if selectionConn then
			selectionConn:Disconnect()
			selectionConn = nil
		end
		stopPreview()
		Importer.unfadeAll() -- a review left open: the default comes back
		-- the panel closed: Studio's own time of day comes back
		Preview.restoreLight()
		if ui.paintLight then ui.paintLight("studio") end
	end
end

-- the plugin is closing: leave nothing behind
function App.unload()
	PreviewTab.leave()
	Importer.unfadeAll()
	stopPreview()
	Preview.destroy()
end

return App
modules.CatalogText:
--[[
	CatalogText — find, replace or insert ONE skin row inside the SkinCatalog
	module source, leaving every other byte as it was.

	The catalogue is one module (~120k characters). Each slot is a block
	`SkinCatalog.<Slot> = { ... }` and each skin a row indented by one tab,
	optionally preceded by a `-- <Key>: ...` comment line:

		-- MidNightLantern: Assets workspace.Lantern.MidNightLantern, tag MidNight (added 2026-09-23)
		MidNightLantern = { price = 100, tier = "Common", pieces = {
			...
		} },

	Some blocks are one line (`SkinCatalog.Door = { Default = { ... } }`); an
	insert turns them into a multi-line block.
]]

local Util = require(script.Parent.Util)

local CatalogText = {}

local function escape(s)
	return (s:gsub("[%^%$%(%)%%%.%[%]%*%+%-%?]", "%%%0"))
end

-- start/end index of the `{` and `}` of SkinCatalog.<Slot> = { ... }
function CatalogText.findBlock(src, slot)
	local _, e = src:find("\nSkinCatalog%." .. escape(slot) .. "%s*=%s*{")
	if not e then return nil end
	local close = Util.matchBrace(src, e)
	if not close then return nil end
	return e, close
end

-- the row of `key` inside a block: rowStart (first char of its comment or key line),
-- rowEnd (last char before the newline that ends the row), and the row text
function CatalogText.findRow(src, open, close, key)
	local pat = "\n\t" .. escape(Util.keyExpr(key)) .. "%s*=%s*{"
	local a, b = src:find(pat, open)
	if not a or a > close then return nil end
	local rowClose = Util.matchBrace(src, b)
	if not rowClose or rowClose > close then return nil end
	-- the rest of the row's last line: a trailing comma and/or comment
	local nl = src:find("\n", rowClose, true) or (close - 1)
	local rowEnd = nl - 1
	local rowStart = a + 1
	-- the comment line above, when it names this key
	local prevStart = src:sub(1, a - 1):match(".*\n()")
	if prevStart then
		local prevLine = src:sub(prevStart, a - 1)
		if prevLine:match("^\t%-%- " .. escape(key) .. ":") then rowStart = prevStart end
	end
	return rowStart, rowEnd, src:sub(rowStart, rowEnd)
end

-- the current row text for `key` in `slot`, or nil
function CatalogText.getRow(src, slot, key)
	local open, close = CatalogText.findBlock(src, slot)
	if not open then return nil end
	local _, _, text = CatalogText.findRow(src, open, close, key)
	return text
end

-- src with `rowText` in place of the key's row (or added at the end of the block).
-- rowText: the full row, comment line included, ending in "," and NO trailing newline
function CatalogText.upsert(src, slot, key, rowText)
