	local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsBody", "Body colours " .. theme)
	local function cancel(msg)
		if rec then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel) end
		return false, msg
	end
	local old = ScriptEditorService:GetEditorSource(module)
	local okSplice, newSource, how = pcall(Paint.upsert, old, theme, Paint.entryText(theme, palette, keep))
	if not okSplice then return cancel(tostring(newSource)) end
	local probe = module:Clone()
	probe.Source = newSource
	local okLoad, data = pcall(require, probe)
	probe:Destroy()
	if not (okLoad and type(data) == "table" and data.Hull and data.Hull[theme] and data.BodyPackage and data.BodyPackage[theme]) then
		return cancel("The new catalogue did not load (" .. tostring(okLoad and "rows missing" or data) .. ") — nothing was changed.")
	end
	-- a plain .Source write, never UpdateSourceAsync: only a property write marks the Package as
	-- changed (ShipSkins.approve, 2026-09-29)
	local okWrite, err = pcall(function()
		module.Source = newSource
	end)
	if not okWrite then return cancel("Could not write SkinCatalog: " .. tostring(err)) end
	if rec then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit) end
	return true, string.format("%s %s's body colours in SkinCatalog's BODY_COLORS (six paint rows + the Body-tab set). Right-click SkinCatalog → Publish Package — paint is on sale as soon as it is published.",
		how == "added" and "Added" or "Updated", theme)
end

-- do two palettes agree on every group BOTH carry? (the older colour ships were never
-- tagged for MastSteps / Stairs, so those groups are simply absent from them)
function Paint.same(a, b)
	if not (a and b) then return false end
	local compared = 0
	for _, g in ipairs(Paint.GROUPS) do
		local x, y = a[g], b[g]
		if x and y then
			compared += 1
			if math.abs(x.R - y.R) + math.abs(x.G - y.G) + math.abs(x.B - y.B) > 3 / 255 then return false end
		end
	end
	return compared > 0
end

return Paint
modules.Preview:
--[[
	Preview — shows a skin on a copy of the ship, exactly where the game puts it.

	The ship is a copy of ServerStorage.ShipTemplate named ZAAL_PreviewShip, with
	Archivable = false: it is never saved into the place, never copied into a
	playtest, and building it adds nothing to the undo history. Scripts are removed
	and every part is anchored (nothing simulates in edit mode anyway).

	WHERE a piece goes comes from SkinSockets — the very module the Arena's and the
	Shipyard's SkinService use — with the same rule as SkinService.mountMesh:
	piece.PivotOffset = the row's pivot, PivotTo(targetCF or socket frame). The
	piece itself is a copy of the designer's part, so its size already is
	MeshSize × scale and its texture / SurfaceAppearance are the real art.
	The extras mirror SkinService's applyExtras: wheel face pose + colours (other
	mouth frames follow MouthHappyRest), the lantern candle rig swap, the board's
	text plane + name (drawn by the game's own ShipNameText).

	Live: while a skin is shown, edits to its model (move, pivot, size, face rig,
	candle rig, text attributes) re-show it on the next frame.
]]

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local SkinSockets = require(script.Parent.SkinSockets)
local ShipNameText = require(script.Parent.ShipNameText)
local Slots = require(script.Parent.Slots)
local Paint = require(script.Parent.Paint)

local Preview = {}

local SHIP_NAME = "ZAAL_PreviewShip"
Preview.SHIP_NAME = SHIP_NAME
Preview.boardName = "SAIL ME"

local state = {
	ship = nil,
	slots = {}, -- [slot] = { restore = { fn, ... }, key = skin key }
	liveConns = {},
	liveSkins = {},
	pending = false,
	onLive = nil,
}

-- the preview ship ------------------------------------------------------------------
local function placeFor(ship)
	local pad = workspace:FindFirstChild("PreviewShipSpawn")
	if pad and pad:IsA("BasePart") then
		return pad.CFrame * CFrame.new(160, 12, 0)
	end
	return CFrame.new(0, 40, 1200)
end

function Preview.ship()
	if state.ship and state.ship.Parent then return state.ship end
	local stale = workspace:FindFirstChild(SHIP_NAME)
	if stale then stale:Destroy() end
	local template = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("ShipTemplate")
	if not template then return nil, "No ServerStorage.ShipTemplate in this place." end
	local ship = template:Clone()
	ship.Name = SHIP_NAME
	ship.Archivable = false
	for _, d in ipairs(ship:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
			d:Destroy()
		elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Anchored = true
		elseif d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
			d.Enabled = false
		end
	end
	ship:PivotTo(placeFor(ship))
	ship.Parent = workspace
	state.ship = ship
	table.clear(state.slots)
	return ship
end

function Preview.exists()
	return state.ship ~= nil and state.ship.Parent ~= nil
end

-- restore bookkeeping ----------------------------------------------------------------
local function remember(slot, fn)
	state.slots[slot] = state.slots[slot] or { restore = {} }
	table.insert(state.slots[slot].restore, fn)
end

-- The game DESTROYS a socket's DefaultMesh when a skin is mounted; the preview must be able to
-- put it back, so it hides instead — and a Texture / Decal still draws on an invisible part
-- (the default door's 46 plank and frame Textures showed through every door skin), so those
-- are hidden with it.
local function hide(slot, part)
	local t = part.Transparency
	part.Transparency = 1
	remember(slot, function() if part.Parent then part.Transparency = t end end)
	for _, d in ipairs(part:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("Decal") then -- Texture is a Decal too
			local dt = d.Transparency
			d.Transparency = 1
			remember(slot, function() if d.Parent then d.Transparency = dt end end)
		end
	end
end

function Preview.clearSlot(slot)
	local s = state.slots[slot]
	if not s then return end
	for i = #s.restore, 1, -1 do pcall(s.restore[i]) end
	state.slots[slot] = nil
end

-- WHEEL SPIN: the wheel turned on the preview ship about the game's own axis — the stand's
-- SpinMotor turns the wheel socket about the socket's Z through its origin (its C1 is the
-- identity on the template), so a skin wheel turns about its PIVOT's Z. An off-centre pivot
-- wobbles. Runs per frame ONLY while switched on; any clear / unload stops it.
local spinConn, spinAngle = nil, 0
local function spinStep(dt)
	spinAngle = (spinAngle + dt * 1.6) % (math.pi * 2)
	local s = state.slots.Wheel
	if not (s and s.mounts) then return end
	for _, m in ipairs(s.mounts) do
		local socket = m.clone.Parent
		if m.socket == "RotationPart" and socket and socket:IsA("BasePart") and m.onSocket then
			local S = socket.CFrame
			m.clone.CFrame = S * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, spinAngle) * m.onSocket
		end
	end
end
function Preview.spinWheel(on)
	if spinConn then
		spinConn:Disconnect()
		spinConn = nil
		-- back to rest
		local s = state.slots.Wheel
		for _, m in ipairs((s and s.mounts) or {}) do
			local socket = m.clone.Parent
			if m.socket == "RotationPart" and socket and socket:IsA("BasePart") and m.onSocket then
				m.clone.CFrame = socket.CFrame * m.onSocket
			end
		end
	end
	if on then spinConn = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(spinStep) end
end
function Preview.spinning() return spinConn ~= nil end

function Preview.clearAll()
	Preview.spinWheel(false)
	for slot in pairs(state.slots) do Preview.clearSlot(slot) end
end

function Preview.destroy()
	Preview.spinWheel(false)
	Preview.stopLive()
	Preview.restoreLight()
	if state.ship then state.ship:Destroy() end
	state.ship = nil
	table.clear(state.slots)
end

-- extras ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function poseFace(slot, ship, rot, face)
	local props = ship:FindFirstChild("Props")
	local faces = props and props:FindFirstChild("Faces")
	local rig = faces and faces:FindFirstChild("ShipWheelFace")
	if not (rig and rot) then return end
	-- remember the authored face
	local savedScale = rig:GetScale()
	local saved = {}
	for _, d in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			local sa = d:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
			saved[d] = { cf = d.CFrame, color = d.Color, sa = sa and sa.Color, saInst = sa }
		end
	end
	remember(slot, function()
		rig:ScaleTo(savedScale)
		for p, v in pairs(saved) do
			if p.Parent then
				p.CFrame = v.cf
				p.Color = v.color
				if v.saInst and v.sa then v.saInst.Color = v.sa end
			end
		end
	end)
	local motors = {}
	for _, d in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("Motor6D") and d.Part0 and d.Part1 then motors[d.Part1] = d end
	end
	local hub = rot:GetPivot()
	rig:ScaleTo(face.FaceScale or savedScale)
	local rest = rig:FindFirstChild("MouthHappyRest", true)
	local restOff = face.Face_MouthHappyRest_Offset
	-- authored offsets AFTER scaling, measured from the hub, for the follow-Rest frames
	local scaledRel = {}
	for p in pairs(saved) do scaledRel[p] = hub:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame) end
	for p in pairs(saved) do
		if not motors[p] then
			local off = face["Face_" .. p.Name .. "_Offset"]
			if typeof(off) ~= "CFrame" and rest and p ~= rest and p.Parent == rest.Parent
				and p.Name:match("^MouthHappy") and typeof(restOff) == "CFrame" then
				off = restOff * scaledRel[rest]:ToObjectSpace(scaledRel[p])
			end
			if typeof(off) == "CFrame" then p.CFrame = hub * off end
		end
	end
	-- anchored preview parts do not follow their motors: place the eyes by hand
	for p, m in pairs(motors) do
		p.CFrame = m.Part0.CFrame * m.C0 * m.C1:Inverse()
	end
	for p, v in pairs(saved) do
		local color = face["Face_" .. p.Name .. "_Color"]
		local saColor = face["Face_" .. p.Name .. "_SAColor"]
		if color == nil and saColor == nil and rest and p ~= rest and p.Name:match("^MouthHappy") then
			color, saColor = face.Face_MouthHappyRest_Color, face.Face_MouthHappyRest_SAColor
		end
		if typeof(color) == "Color3" then p.Color = color end
		if v.saInst and typeof(saColor) == "Color3" then v.saInst.Color = saColor end
	end
	-- the posed face, to tell a later drag on the ship from the model's own pose
	local snap = {}
	for p in pairs(saved) do snap[p] = p.CFrame end
	if state.slots[slot] then
		state.slots[slot].faceSnapshot = snap
		state.slots[slot].faceScale = rig:GetScale()
	end
end

local function swapCandle(slot, item, candle)
	local fitile = item:FindFirstChild("Fitile", true)
	if not fitile then return end
	local removed = {}
	local enabled = true
	for _, c in ipairs(fitile:GetChildren()) do
		if (c:IsA("Light") or c:IsA("ParticleEmitter")) and not c:GetAttribute("FixedLight") then
			enabled = enabled and c.Enabled
			table.insert(removed, c)
			c.Parent = nil
		end
	end
	local added = {}
	for _, c in ipairs(candle:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("Light") or c:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			local k = c:Clone()
			k.Enabled = enabled
			k.Parent = fitile
			table.insert(added, k)
		end
	end
	remember(slot, function()
		for _, k in ipairs(added) do k:Destroy() end
		for _, c in ipairs(removed) do c.Parent = fitile end
	end)
end

local function styleOf(text)
	local font = ShipNameText.FONT
	if text.font then
		local weight, style = Enum.FontWeight.Regular, Enum.FontStyle.Normal
		for _, w in Enum.FontWeight:GetEnumItems() do if w.Name == text.weight then weight = w end end
		for _, s in Enum.FontStyle:GetEnumItems() do if s.Name == text.style then style = s end end
		font = Font.new(text.font, weight, style)
	end
	return {
		font = font,
		color = text.color or ShipNameText.COLOR,
		outline = text.outline or ShipNameText.OUTLINE,
		thick = text.thickness or ShipNameText.THICK,
		scale = text.scale or 1,
		curve = text.curve,
	}
end

local function showBoardText(slot, item, text)
	local plane = item:FindFirstChild("BoardTextPlane")
	if not plane then return end
	local cf, size = plane.CFrame, plane.Size
	local oldGui = plane:FindFirstChild("ShipNameGui")
	if oldGui then oldGui.Parent = nil end
	if text then
		plane.Size = text.size
		plane.CFrame = item.CFrame * text.plane
	end
	local gui = ShipNameText.build(plane.Size, Preview.boardName, text and styleOf(text) or ShipNameText.styleFromBoard(item))
	if gui then gui.Parent = plane end
	if state.slots[slot] then state.slots[slot].planeExpected = { plane = plane, cf = plane.CFrame, size = plane.Size } end
	remember(slot, function()
		if gui then gui:Destroy() end
		plane.CFrame, plane.Size = cf, size
		if oldGui then oldGui.Parent = plane end
	end)
end

-- show one skin -----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- skin = { slot, key, model }, plan = ShipSkins.inspect(...).plan
function Preview.show(skin, plan)
	local ship, why = Preview.ship()
	if not ship then return false, why end
	local slot = skin.slot
	Preview.clearSlot(slot)
	state.slots[slot] = { restore = {}, key = skin.key, mounts = {}, model = skin.model, plan = plan }
	local def = Slots.SHIP[slot]

	if def.texture then
		if not plan.sail then return false, "No SurfaceAppearance to show." end
		for _, part in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("SkinSurface_" .. slot)) do
			if part:IsDescendantOf(ship) and part:IsA("MeshPart") then
				local old = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
				if old then old.Parent = nil end
				local sa = plan.sail:Clone()
				sa.Parent = part
				remember(slot, function()
					sa:Destroy()
					if old then old.Parent = part end
				end)
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	local geo = SkinSockets.slots[slot]
	if not geo then return false, "The game has no " .. slot .. " slot." end
	local mounted = 0
	for _, item in ipairs(geo.items(ship)) do
		local sockets = geo.sockets(item)
		local mountedOn = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(plan.pieces) do
			local socket = sockets[p.socket]
			if socket then
				local clone = p.part:Clone()
				for _, ch in ipairs(clone:GetChildren()) do
					if not ch:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then ch:Destroy() end
				end
				-- SkinService.stampDefaults: the socket's authored mesh lends its look
				local dm = socket:FindFirstChild("DefaultMesh")
				if dm then
					clone.CastShadow, clone.Reflectance, clone.Material = dm.CastShadow, dm.Reflectance, dm.Material
				end
				clone.Transparency = p.transparency or 0
				clone.PivotOffset = p.pivot
				clone.Anchored, clone.CanCollide, clone.CanQuery, clone.CanTouch = true, false, false, false
				clone.Name = socket.Name .. "Preview"
				clone:SetAttribute("SkinMesh", true)
				local target = geo.targetCF and geo.targetCF(p.socket, sockets, { rig = def.rig }) or socket.CFrame
				clone:PivotTo(target)
				clone.Parent = socket
				local placed = clone.CFrame
				if geo.postMount then geo.postMount(p.socket, sockets, clone) end
				-- what the game would do with this piece, to read a designer's drag back later
				table.insert(state.slots[slot].mounts, { clone = clone, part = p.part, target = target,
					expected = clone.CFrame, shift = clone.CFrame.Position - placed.Position, size = clone.Size, item = item, socket = p.socket, alpha = clone.Transparency,
					onSocket = socket.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(clone.CFrame) })
				mountedOn[socket] = true
				mounted += 1
				remember(slot, function() clone:Destroy() end)
			end
		end
		for _, part in ipairs(geo.hideParts(item)) do
			if part.Name ~= "DefaultMesh" then
				if mountedOn[part.Parent] then hide(slot, part) end
			elseif next(mountedOn) then
				hide(slot, part)
			end
		end
		if plan.candle then swapCandle(slot, item, plan.candle) end
		if slot == "Board" then showBoardText(slot, item, plan.text) end
		if plan.face then poseFace(slot, ship, sockets.RotationPart, plan.face) end
		if slot == "Cannon" then Preview.applyMouth() end
		if slot == "Window" then Preview.applyWindow() end
		if slot == "Anchor" then Preview.applyAnchor() end
	end
	if mounted == 0 then return false, "No socket on the ship took a piece — check the piece names." end
	return true
end

-- CANNON MOUTH: in game the mouth shows the ammo (CannonService): loaded = CloseMouth only,
-- empty / reloading = OpenMouth + Tongue. The preview shows one state at a time, like the
-- game, instead of all three meshes on top of each other. Preview-only: the model is untouched.
Preview.mouth = "loaded" -- "loaded" | "unloaded"
local MOUTH_SHOWN = { loaded = { CloseMouth = true }, unloaded = { OpenMouth = true, Tongue = true } }
function Preview.applyMouth()
	local s = state.slots.Cannon
	if not (s and s.mounts) then return end
	local shown = MOUTH_SHOWN[Preview.mouth] or MOUTH_SHOWN.loaded
	for _, m in ipairs(s.mounts) do
		if m.clone.Parent and (m.socket == "CloseMouth" or m.socket == "OpenMouth" or m.socket == "Tongue") then
			m.clone.Transparency = shown[m.socket] and m.alpha or 1
		end
	end
end

-- GUNNER'S VIEW: the camera exactly where a player sits manning the cannon. CannonMode puts
-- it at RotationPart:GetPivot() * CAM_REL (Shayan's authored gunner shot, riding yaw + pitch).
-- CAM_REL is COPIED from SailMe-Arena1 src/client/CannonMode.client.luau — keep them in step.
local GUNNER_CAM_REL = CFrame.new(
	-2.713669, 2.577927, 0.065125,
	0.00663178, 0.02580157, -0.99965626,
	-0.00001654, 0.99968779, 0.02580061,
	0.99999893, -0.00015477, 0.00663549)
function Preview.focusGunner(index)
	local ship = Preview.ship()
	if not ship then return false end
	local items = SkinSockets.slots.Cannon.items(ship)
	local cannon = items[((index or 1) - 1) % math.max(#items, 1) + 1]
	local rot = cannon and cannon:FindFirstChild("RotationPart")
	if not (rot and rot:IsA("BasePart")) then return false end
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	cam.CFrame = rot:GetPivot() * GUNNER_CAM_REL
	cam.Focus = CFrame.new(rot:GetPivot().Position)
	return true
end

-- ANCHOR DOWN / UP / TRICK, as ShipVisualsClient draws the capstan (numbers COPIED from it —
-- keep them in step): the drum turns 360° from down to up, so only the cap differs: it rises
-- CENTER_LIFT out of the drum when up. In the trick (possessed anchor) each hand slides out
-- along the bar, at most CURSE_HAND_REACH from its rest pose, the two opposite ways; the preview
-- shows that full reach, still (the game also rocks and twists them).
local ANCHOR_CENTER_LIFT = 0.48
local ANCHOR_HAND_REACH = 2.1
Preview.anchorMode = "down" -- "down" | "up" | "trick"
function Preview.applyAnchor()
	local s = state.slots.Anchor
	if not (s and s.mounts) then return end
	for _, m in ipairs(s.mounts) do
		local socket = m.clone.Parent
		if socket and socket:IsA("BasePart") and m.onSocket and m.item then
			local base = socket.CFrame * m.onSocket
			local ok, sockets = pcall(SkinSockets.slots.Anchor.sockets, m.item)
			sockets = ok and sockets or {}
			local barRot = ((sockets.LeftHand or socket).CFrame).Rotation
			if m.socket == "CenterPart" and Preview.anchorMode == "up" then
				base = base + barRot:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, ANCHOR_CENTER_LIFT, 0))
			elseif (m.socket == "LeftHand" or m.socket == "RightHand") and Preview.anchorMode == "trick" then
				-- the hand's own bar-aligned frame at its wrist pivot; outward = the side of the drum
				-- axis the hand's centre lies on (ShipVisualsClient's dir)
				local frame = CFrame.new((socket.CFrame * socket.PivotOffset).Position) * socket.CFrame.Rotation
				local drum = sockets.RotationPart
				local dir = (drum and (socket.Position - drum.Position):Dot(frame.XVector) < 0) and -1 or 1
				base = base + frame.XVector * dir * ANCHOR_HAND_REACH
			end
			m.clone.CFrame = base
		end
	end
end

-- WINDOW OPEN / CLOSED: the game's WindowService swings the cover by SWING (~66° awning, up
-- and out) from wherever it sits closed: open cover = cover * SWING. The two poses are COPIED
-- from SailMe-Arena1 src/server/WindowService.server.luau (CLOSED_REF / OPEN_REF) — that script
-- is not a module the plugin can load. Keep them in step if the window swing ever changes.
local WINDOW_CLOSED_REF = CFrame.new(-0.7198829650878906, 0.3755035400390625, -0.26318359375,
	0.5154213309288025, -0.8569385409355164, 0, 0.8569352626800537, 0.5154240131378174, 0, 0, 0, 1)
local WINDOW_OPEN_REF = CFrame.new(-2.0221099853515625, 1.6702957153320312, -0.2650146484375,
	0.9916275143623352, 0.12914177775382996, 0, -0.12913769483566284, 0.9916266798973083, 0, 0, 0, 1)
local WINDOW_SWING = WINDOW_CLOSED_REF:Inverse() * WINDOW_OPEN_REF
Preview.window = "closed" -- "closed" | "open"
function Preview.applyWindow()
	local s = state.slots.Window
	if not (s and s.mounts) then return end
	for _, m in ipairs(s.mounts) do
		local cover = m.clone.Parent
		if m.socket == "CoverPart" and cover and cover:IsA("BasePart") then
			-- the clone rides the cover: swing the cover's frame, keep the clone's place on it
			local swing = Preview.window == "open" and (cover.CFrame * WINDOW_SWING * cover.CFrame:Inverse()) or CFrame.new()
			-- from the socket as it is NOW, not as it was when shown (the socket can be moved under a live preview)
			m.clone.CFrame = swing * cover.CFrame * (m.onSocket or cover.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(m.expected))
		end
	end
end

-- BODY PAINT --------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The body's colours are the paint groups (Hull, Deck, Rim, Mast, MastSteps, Stairs): a theme's
-- BODY_COLORS entry in the catalogue, else its colour ship in workspace.ship. Painted with
-- SkinService's rule (Paint.apply); every change is remembered and undone on clear.
Preview.PAINT_SLOTS = Paint.GROUPS

-- palette { [group] = Color3 } for a theme + where it came from (nil palette when none).
-- A texture-style body comes back as { style = <style key> } instead of colours.
function Preview.paletteFor(theme, catalog)
	local styleKey = Paint.styleKey(catalog, theme)
	if styleKey then
		return { style = styleKey }, "the catalogue's " .. styleKey .. " texture style"
			.. (styleKey ~= theme and (" (" .. theme .. "'s body)") or "")
	end
	local fromCat = Paint.fromCatalog(catalog, theme)
	if fromCat then return fromCat, "the catalogue's " .. theme .. " paint" end
	local donor = Paint.findDonor(theme)
	if donor then
		local p = Paint.read(donor)
		if next(p) then return p, "the colour ship workspace.ship." .. donor.Name .. " (not in the shop catalogue yet)" end
	end
	return nil, nil
end

-- TEXTURE STYLES (2026-09-28): a style body is per-part data in SkinCatalog.SkinStyles
-- ([style][group]["<path from the ship root>"] = override), applied with the style rule of
-- SkinService.applyTextureSlot: a tagged part with an override takes its SurfaceAppearance
-- (SkinAppearances.<Group>.<Style>.<sa>, or none for saRemove), colour, material and
-- MaterialVariant, and its own Texture overlays (not ones tagged for another group) take the
-- override's texture + tint; a tagged Texture is looked up as "<path>@<Face>" first. Parts
-- without an override keep the authored look, which the preview ship already has.
local function relPath(inst, root)
	local seg = {}
	local n = inst
	while n and n ~= root do
		table.insert(seg, 1, n.Name)
		n = n.Parent
	end
	return table.concat(seg, ".")
end

local function stylesData()
	local cat = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("SkinCatalog")
	local m = cat and cat:FindFirstChild("SkinStyles")
	if not m then return nil end
	local ok, data = pcall(require, m:Clone()) -- a clone, so a stale require cache never lies
	return ok and type(data) == "table" and data or nil
end

local function paintStyle(ship, key, keep)
	local styles = stylesData()
	local style = styles and styles[key]
	if not style then return false end
	local saRoot = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("SkinAppearances")
	local function retexture(tex, ov)
		if not (ov and (ov.texture or ov.textureTint)) then return end
		local c3, img = tex.Color3, tex.Texture
		if ov.textureTint then tex.Color3 = ov.textureTint end
		if ov.texture then tex.Texture = "rbxassetid://" .. ov.texture end
		keep(function() tex.Color3 = c3; tex.Texture = img end)
	end
	for group, parts in pairs(style) do
		local myTag = "SkinSurface_" .. group
		local saGroup = saRoot and saRoot:FindFirstChild(group)
		local saFolder = saGroup and saGroup:FindFirstChild(key)
		for _, inst in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(myTag)) do
			if not inst:IsDescendantOf(ship) then continue end
			if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
				local ov = parts[relPath(inst, ship)]
				if not ov then continue end
				local source = ov.sa and saFolder and saFolder:FindFirstChild(ov.sa)
				if source or ov.saRemove then
					for _, sa in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
						if sa:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
							sa.Parent = nil
							keep(function() sa.Parent = inst end)
						end
					end
					if source then
						local c = source:Clone()
						c.Parent = inst
						keep(function() c:Destroy() end)
					end
				end
				local color, material, variant = inst.Color, inst.Material, inst.MaterialVariant
				if ov.color then inst.Color = ov.color end
				if ov.material and Enum.Material[ov.material] then inst.Material = Enum.Material[ov.material] end
				if ov.materialVariant then inst.MaterialVariant = ov.materialVariant end
				keep(function() inst.Color = color; inst.Material = material; inst.MaterialVariant = variant end)
				for _, k in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
					if k:IsA("Texture") then
						local foreign = false
						for _, t in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTags(k)) do
							if t:find("^SkinSurface_") and t ~= myTag then foreign = true break end
						end
						if not foreign then retexture(k, ov) end
					end
				end
			elseif inst:IsA("Texture") then
				local rp = relPath(inst, ship)
				retexture(inst, parts[rp .. "@" .. inst.Face.Name] or parts[rp])
			end
		end
	end
	return true
end

function Preview.paint(palette)
	local ship = Preview.ship()
	if not ship then return false end
	Preview.clearSlot("Paint")
	if not palette then return true end
	state.slots.Paint = { restore = {} }
	local keep = function(fn) remember("Paint", fn) end
	if palette.style then return paintStyle(ship, palette.style, keep) end
	Paint.apply(ship, palette, keep)
	return true
end

-- LIGHTING --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Day / sunset / night on Lighting.ClockTime, to judge a set (and its lantern light) in both
-- lights. The original time is remembered and put back on restore / when the plugin closes, so
-- a save never keeps the night.
local savedClock = nil
Preview.LIGHTS = { day = 14, sunset = 18.2, night = 22 }
function Preview.setLight(mode)
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	if savedClock == nil then savedClock = Lighting.ClockTime end
	Lighting.ClockTime = Preview.LIGHTS[mode] or savedClock
	Preview.lightMode = Preview.LIGHTS[mode] and mode or nil
end
function Preview.restoreLight()
	if savedClock ~= nil then
		game:GetService("Lighting").ClockTime = savedClock
		savedClock = nil
	end
	Preview.lightMode = nil
end
function Preview.lightChanged() return savedClock ~= nil end

-- EDITS BACK TO THE MODEL ------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The designer may drag / rotate / resize a preview piece on the ship with Studio's tools. Taking
-- it back: the piece's authored PivotOffset becomes the one that lands it where it now is
-- (PivotTo(target) with pivot P puts the part at target * P⁻¹, so P = cframe⁻¹ * target; a door's
-- hinge spread is added by the game after the pivot, so it is taken off first) and its Size is
-- copied (scale = Size / MeshSize). Window pieces also get their FitScale / FitOffset attributes.
-- Returns a list of plain-words changes, applied to the Assets model.
-- give an Assets piece a new pivot WITHOUT moving its socket point: the piece (and anything
-- nested in it, like a board's name plane) moves so that it sits where the new pivot says —
-- so the model in the folder always shows what the ship will show, and its layout stays
-- consistent for the pivot check
function Preview.setPivot(part, newPivot)
	local socketPoint = part.CFrame * part.PivotOffset
	local before = part.CFrame
	part.PivotOffset = newPivot
	part.CFrame = socketPoint * newPivot:Inverse()
	local delta = part.CFrame * before:Inverse()
	for _, d in ipairs(part:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.CFrame = delta * d.CFrame end
	end
	if part:GetAttribute("FitOffset") ~= nil then part:SetAttribute("FitOffset", newPivot.Position) end
end

-- resize an Assets piece about its pivot: the socket point stays put and the pivot keeps its
-- spot on the (now bigger / smaller) mesh, so pieces sharing one pivot (a door leaf and its
-- glass) scale together as one. Window fit attributes follow.
function Preview.scale(piece, factor)
	local pivotWorld = piece.CFrame * piece.PivotOffset
	piece.Size = piece.Size * factor
	piece.PivotOffset = CFrame.new(piece.PivotOffset.Position * factor) * piece.PivotOffset.Rotation
	piece.CFrame = pivotWorld * piece.PivotOffset:Inverse()
	local native = piece:GetAttribute("NativeSize")
	if typeof(native) == "Vector3" and native.X > 0 then piece:SetAttribute("FitScale", piece.Size / native) end
	if piece:GetAttribute("FitOffset") ~= nil then piece:SetAttribute("FitOffset", piece.PivotOffset.Position) end
end

function Preview.pull(slot)
	local s = state.slots[slot]
	if not s or not s.mounts then return {} end
	-- an OPEN window's cover is swung on purpose: close it first, or the swing reads as an edit
	if slot == "Window" and Preview.window == "open" then
		Preview.window = "closed"
		Preview.applyWindow()
	end
	if slot == "Anchor" and Preview.anchorMode ~= "down" then
		Preview.anchorMode = "down"
		Preview.applyAnchor()
	end
	local changes, done = {}, {}
	for _, m in ipairs(s.mounts) do
		if m.clone.Parent and not done[m.part] then
			local _, turned = (m.clone.CFrame.Rotation:Inverse() * m.expected.Rotation):ToAxisAngle()
			local moved = (m.clone.CFrame.Position - m.expected.Position).Magnitude > 1e-4 or math.abs(turned) > 1e-4
			local resized = (m.clone.Size - m.size).Magnitude > 1e-4
			if moved or resized then
				done[m.part] = true
				local pose = m.clone.CFrame - m.shift
				local newPivot = pose:Inverse() * m.target
				if resized then
					m.part.Size = m.clone.Size
					local native = m.part:GetAttribute("NativeSize")
					if typeof(native) == "Vector3" and native.X > 0 then
						m.part:SetAttribute("FitScale", m.part.Size / native)
					end
				end
				Preview.setPivot(m.part, newPivot)
				table.insert(changes, m.part.Name .. (moved and " moved" or "") .. (resized and " resized" or ""))
			end
		end
	end
	-- the wheel face: its parts' poses go back onto the model's FaceRig, relative to the hub
	if slot == "Wheel" and s.model:FindFirstChild("FaceRig") then
		local ship = state.ship
		local faces = ship and ship:FindFirstChild("Props") and ship.Props:FindFirstChild("Faces")
		local face = faces and faces:FindFirstChild("ShipWheelFace")
		local shipHub
		for _, m in ipairs(s.mounts) do
			if m.clone.Parent and m.clone.Parent.Name == "RotationPart" then shipHub = m.clone.Parent end
		end
		local modelHub
		for _, p in ipairs(s.model:GetChildren()) do
			if p:IsA("MeshPart") and Slots.socketFor(Slots.SHIP.Wheel, p.Name) == "RotationPart" then modelHub = p end
		end
		if face and shipHub and modelHub and s.faceSnapshot then
			local rig = s.model.FaceRig
			local movedAny = false
			for _, part in ipairs(face:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and s.faceSnapshot[part] and (part.CFrame.Position - s.faceSnapshot[part].Position).Magnitude > 1e-4 then
					movedAny = true
				end
			end
			if movedAny or math.abs(face:GetScale() - (s.faceScale or face:GetScale())) > 1e-4 then
				rig:ScaleTo(face:GetScale())
				local map = modelHub:GetPivot() * shipHub:GetPivot():Inverse()
				for _, part in ipairs(face:GetDescendants()) do
					if part:IsA("BasePart") then
						local path = part:GetFullName():sub(#face:GetFullName() + 2)
						local target = rig
						for seg in path:gmatch("[^%.]+") do target = target and target:FindFirstChild(seg) end
						if target and target:IsA("BasePart") then target.CFrame = map * part.CFrame end
					end
				end
				table.insert(changes, "face moved")
			end
		end
	end
	-- the board's text plane goes back onto the model's BoardTextPlane
	if slot == "Board" and s.planeExpected then
		local plane = s.planeExpected.plane
		if plane.Parent and ((plane.CFrame.Position - s.planeExpected.cf.Position).Magnitude > 1e-4 or (plane.Size - s.planeExpected.size).Magnitude > 1e-4) then
			local modelPlane = s.model:FindFirstChild("BoardTextPlane", true)
			local piece = modelPlane and modelPlane.Parent
			local socket = plane.Parent
			if modelPlane and piece and piece:IsA("BasePart") then
				local pieceFrame = piece.CFrame * piece.PivotOffset
				modelPlane.CFrame = pieceFrame * socket.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(plane.CFrame)
				modelPlane.Size = plane.Size
				table.insert(changes, "name plane moved")
			end
		end
	end
	return changes
end

-- the preview pieces of a slot (to select them on the ship)
function Preview.clones(slot)
	local out = {}
	local s = state.slots[slot]
	for _, m in ipairs(s and s.mounts or {}) do
		if m.clone.Parent then table.insert(out, m.clone) end
	end
	return out
end

-- the camera on the slot's first item
-- SAVED FIRST VIEWS: the owner frames a slot once ("Use this view first") and every preview of
-- that slot opens there: which item it looked at and the camera relative to that item, kept in
-- this computer's plugin settings (keys without dots — see Website).
local pluginRef
function Preview.init(plugin) pluginRef = plugin end
local function viewKey(slot) return "ZAALAssets_View_" .. slot end

function Preview.savedView(slot)
	local v = pluginRef and pluginRef:GetSetting(viewKey(slot))
	return (type(v) == "table" and type(v.c) == "table" and #v.c == 12) and v or nil
end

-- where an item sits on the ship, in the hull's frame: stable across preview-ship rebuilds. List
-- order is not, and many items share a name (11 lanterns, 8 of them "LanthernModel").
local function shipFrame(ship)
	local hull = ship:FindFirstChild("Hull")
	return (hull and hull:IsA("BasePart")) and hull.CFrame or ship:GetPivot()
end

-- an item's frame that skins never move: its first socket part (a Model's pivot comes from its
-- bounding box, which changes as skin pieces are mounted inside it)
local function itemFrame(slot, item)
	local ok, sockets = pcall(SkinSockets.slots[slot].sockets, item)
	if ok and type(sockets) == "table" then
		local names = {}
		for k, part in pairs(sockets) do
			if typeof(part) == "Instance" and part:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(names, k) end
		end
		table.sort(names)
		if names[1] then return sockets[names[1]].CFrame end
	end
	return item:GetPivot()
end

-- remember the current camera as the slot's first view: the item SELECTED in Studio when one is,
-- else the one nearest the middle of the screen
function Preview.saveView(slot)
	local ship = Preview.ship()
	if not (ship and pluginRef) then return false, "No preview ship." end
	local items = SkinSockets.slots[slot] and SkinSockets.slots[slot].items(ship) or {}
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local pick
	local sel = game:GetService("Selection"):Get()[1]
	if sel then
		for _, it in ipairs(items) do
			if sel == it or sel:IsDescendantOf(it) then pick = it break end
		end
	end
	if not pick then
		local bestFacing
		for _, it in ipairs(items) do
			local to = it:GetPivot().Position - cam.CFrame.Position
			local facing = cam.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(to.Unit)
			if facing > 0.5 and (not bestFacing or facing > bestFacing) then pick, bestFacing = it, facing end
		end
	end
	if not pick then return false, "Select a " .. slot:lower() .. " on the preview ship (or point the camera at one) first." end
	local frame = itemFrame(slot, pick)
	local rel = frame:ToObjectSpace(cam.CFrame)
	local at = shipFrame(ship):PointToObjectSpace(frame.Position)
	pluginRef:SetSetting(viewKey(slot), { at = { at.X, at.Y, at.Z }, c = { rel:GetComponents() } })
	return true, pick.Name
end

-- the item a saved view belongs to: the one sitting where it was saved
local function viewItem(ship, slot, saved)
	local items = SkinSockets.slots[slot].items(ship)
	if type(saved.at) ~= "table" then return items[saved.i or 1], #items end -- saved by the first build
	local at = Vector3.new(saved.at[1], saved.at[2], saved.at[3])
	local frame = shipFrame(ship)
	local best, bestD
	for _, it in ipairs(items) do
		local d = (frame:PointToObjectSpace(itemFrame(slot, it).Position) - at).Magnitude
		if not bestD or d < bestD then best, bestD = it, d end
	end
	return best, #items
end

function Preview.forgetView(slot)
	if pluginRef then pluginRef:SetSetting(viewKey(slot), nil) end
end

function Preview.focus(slot, index)
	local ship = Preview.ship()
	if not ship then return end
	-- the first look at a slot uses the saved view when there is one
	local saved = (index or 1) == 1 and not Slots.SHIP[slot].texture and Preview.savedView(slot)
	if saved then
		local item, count = viewItem(ship, slot, saved)
		if item then
			local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local frame = (type(saved.at) == "table") and itemFrame(slot, item) or item:GetPivot()
			cam.CFrame = frame * CFrame.new(table.unpack(saved.c))
			cam.Focus = CFrame.new(frame.Position)
			return count
		end
	end
	local target
	if Slots.SHIP[slot].texture then
		for _, part in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("SkinSurface_" .. slot)) do
			if part:IsDescendantOf(ship) then target = part break end
		end
	else
		local items = SkinSockets.slots[slot].items(ship)
		target = items[((index or 1) - 1) % math.max(#items, 1) + 1]
	end
	if not target then return 0 end
	local cf, size
	if target:IsA("Model") or target:IsA("Folder") then
		if target:IsA("Model") then
			cf, size = target:GetBoundingBox()
		else
			local m = Instance.new("Model")
			local parts = {}
			for _, d in ipairs(target:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(parts, d) end end
			cf = parts[1] and parts[1].CFrame or ship:GetPivot()
			size = Vector3.new(8, 8, 8)
			m:Destroy()
		end
	else
		cf, size = target.CFrame, target.Size
	end
	-- look from outside the ship, level-ish: the item's direction from the hull centre,
	-- flattened; an item on the centre line (wheel, anchor) is seen from astern-and-aside
	local hull = ship:FindFirstChild("Hull")
	local hcf = hull and hull.CFrame or ship:GetPivot()
	local out = cf.Position - hcf.Position
	out = out - out:Dot(hcf.UpVector) * hcf.UpVector
	local side = out:Dot(hcf.RightVector)
	if math.abs(side) < 3 then
		out = -hcf.LookVector * 0.8 + hcf.RightVector * 0.6
	else
		out = hcf.RightVector * math.sign(side) - hcf.LookVector * 0.35
	end
	-- items with a face that matters are seen from the front: the board from its
	-- text plane's Front, the wheel from the hub toward Billy's face
	if slot == "Board" then
		local plane = target:FindFirstChild("BoardTextPlane")
		if plane then
			cf = plane.CFrame
			out = plane.CFrame.LookVector
		end
	elseif slot == "Wheel" then
		local faces = ship:FindFirstChild("Props") and ship.Props:FindFirstChild("Faces")
		local face = faces and faces:FindFirstChild("ShipWheelFace")
		local hub = target:FindFirstChild("RotationPart")
		if face and hub then
			local d = face:GetPivot().Position - hub.Position
			if d.Magnitude > 1e-3 then out = d.Unit end
		end
	end
	local dist = math.clamp(size.Magnitude * 2.2, 8, 60)
	local eye = cf.Position + (out.Unit + hcf.UpVector * 0.3).Unit * dist
	-- the guessed side can be the item's back, behind a wall (the cabin door is on the centre
	-- line but faces the bow, so "from astern" looked at the cabin's back wall): take the
	-- first of guess / opposite / the two sides from which nothing hides the item
	if slot ~= "Board" and slot ~= "Wheel" then
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { target }
		for _, deg in ipairs({ 0, 180, 90, -90 }) do
			local o = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(hcf.UpVector, math.rad(deg)):VectorToWorldSpace(out)
			local e = cf.Position + (o.Unit + hcf.UpVector * 0.3).Unit * dist
			if not workspace:Raycast(e, cf.Position - e, params) then
				eye = e
				break
			end
		end
	end
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(eye, cf.Position)
	cam.Focus = CFrame.new(cf.Position)
	if Slots.SHIP[slot].texture then return 1 end
	return #SkinSockets.slots[slot].items(ship)
end

-- the whole ship in view, seen the way the Studio camera already looks: only the distance
-- and the point it looks at change. Framed on the ship's own visible parts: the wind-streak
-- VFX parts float up to ~300 studs away (the full bounding box was 466 studs long, so the
-- camera ended far out over the baseplate).
local FRAME_RADIUS = 110 -- studs from the hull; the flag top is ~90
function Preview.focusShip()
	local ship = Preview.ship()
	if not ship then return end
	local hull = ship:FindFirstChild("Hull")
	local c = (hull and hull:IsA("BasePart")) and hull.Position or ship:GetPivot().Position
	local lo, hi
	for _, p in ipairs(ship:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Transparency < 0.99 and (p.Position - c).Magnitude < FRAME_RADIUS then
			local e = p.Size / 2
			lo = lo and lo:Min(p.Position - e) or (p.Position - e)
			hi = hi and hi:Max(p.Position + e) or (p.Position + e)
		end
	end
	local centre = lo and (lo + hi) / 2 or c
	local radius = lo and math.max((hi - lo).Magnitude / 2, 10) or 40
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local look = cam.CFrame.LookVector
	-- far enough for the ship's sphere to fit the narrower of the two view angles
	local vfov = math.rad(cam.FieldOfView) / 2
	local vp = cam.ViewportSize
	local hfov = math.atan(math.tan(vfov) * math.max(vp.X, 1) / math.max(vp.Y, 1))
	local dist = radius / math.sin(math.min(vfov, hfov)) * 0.85
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(centre - look * dist, centre)
	cam.Focus = CFrame.new(centre)
end

-- live updates ------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Preview.stopLive()
	for _, c in ipairs(state.liveConns) do c:Disconnect() end
	table.clear(state.liveConns)
	table.clear(state.liveSkins)
end

-- re-run `onChange` (coalesced to one per frame) whenever any watched model changes
function Preview.watch(models, onChange)
	Preview.stopLive()
	local function queue()
		if state.pending then return end
		state.pending = true
		task.defer(function()
			state.pending = false
			onChange()
		end)
	end
	local WATCH = { CFrame = true, PivotOffset = true, Size = true, Color = true, Transparency = true,
		Brightness = true, Range = true, Enabled = true, TextureID = true, DoubleSided = true, Material = true }
	local function hook(inst)
		table.insert(state.liveConns, inst.Changed:Connect(function(prop)
			if WATCH[prop] or inst:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or inst:IsA("Light") or inst:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then queue() end
		end))
	end
	for _, model in ipairs(models) do
		table.insert(state.liveConns, model.AttributeChanged:Connect(queue))
		table.insert(state.liveConns, model.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d) hook(d) queue() end))
		table.insert(state.liveConns, model.DescendantRemoving:Connect(queue))
		if model:IsA("BasePart") then hook(model) end
		for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Light") or d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then hook(d) end
		end
	end
end

function Preview.shownKey(slot)
	return state.slots[slot] and state.slots[slot].key
end

return Preview
modules.PreviewTab:
--[[
	PreviewTab — the Preview tab: a whole skin set on the ship, tuned until it looks right.

	Left: themes. Picking one dresses ZAAL_PreviewShip with the theme's skins in every slot
	and paints the body in its colours. Right:
	  Lighting   Day / Sunset / Night (Lighting.ClockTime, put back on Restore / close)
	  The set    each slot's skin, swappable with ‹ › (any skin of that slot, or Default)
	  Adjust     the chosen slot's pieces: nudge move / rotate / scale — written to the
	             Assets piece's PivotOffset / Size, one undo step each; the ship updates at
	             once. Or drag the preview piece on the ship with Studio's tools and press
	             "Take my edits from the ship" (pivots, sizes, window fit attributes, the
	             wheel face, the board's name plane go back onto the Assets model).
	  Attributes the skin model's attributes, edited live (numbers, vectors, colours,
	             booleans, text).
	Every edit is to the Assets model, so Approve in the Ship skins tab takes it to the shop.
]]

local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Selection = game:GetService("Selection")

local Theme = require(script.Parent.Theme)
local ShipSkins = require(script.Parent.ShipSkins)
local Preview = require(script.Parent.Preview)
local Slots = require(script.Parent.Slots)
local Paint = require(script.Parent.Paint)
local Website = require(script.Parent.Website)

local new, T, col = Theme.new, Theme.text, Theme.color

local PreviewTab = {}

local ctx -- { ui, toast, themes = fn, rerender = fn }
local tab = {
	theme = nil,
	set = {}, -- [slot] = skin key | "Default"
	focus = nil, -- slot being adjusted
	piece = 1,
	move = 0.05, rot = 5, scale = 0.02,
	body = true,
	light = nil,
}

function PreviewTab.init(context)
	ctx = context
end

local function recorded(name, fn)
	local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsTune", name)
	local ok, err = pcall(fn)
	if rec then
		ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, ok and Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit or Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel)
	end
	return ok, err
end

-- skins by slot, and the ones a theme has
local function bySlot()
	local out = {}
	for _, s in ipairs(ShipSkins.scan()) do
		out[s.slot] = out[s.slot] or {}
		table.insert(out[s.slot], s)
	end
	return out
end

local function find(slot, key)
	for _, s in ipairs(bySlot()[slot] or {}) do
		if s.key == key then return s end
	end
	return nil
end

-- dress the ship with the current set (+ body paint)
local function apply()
	Preview.stopLive()
	Preview.clearAll()
	local models, shown = {}, 0
	for _, slot in ipairs(Slots.ORDER) do
		local key = tab.set[slot]
		local skin = key and key ~= "Default" and find(slot, key)
		if skin then
			local r = ShipSkins.inspect(skin, Website.get(skin.key, skin.slot) or nil)
			if r.plan and Preview.show(skin, r.plan) then
				shown += 1
				table.insert(models, skin.model)
			end
		end
	end
	if tab.body and tab.theme then
		local palette = Preview.paletteFor(tab.theme, ShipSkins.catalogData())
		Preview.paint(palette)
	else
		Preview.paint(nil)
	end
	-- edits to any shown model re-dress the ship on the next frame
	Preview.watch(models, function()
		if ctx.active() then apply() end
	end)
	return shown
end
PreviewTab.apply = apply

local function pickTheme(theme) -- also PreviewTab.pick
	tab.theme = theme
	tab.set = {}
	tab.focus = nil
	for slot, list in pairs(bySlot()) do
		for _, s in ipairs(list) do
			if ShipSkins.inTheme(s, theme) and not tab.set[slot] then tab.set[slot] = s.key end
		end
	end
	local n = apply()
	Preview.focusShip()
	ctx.toast("Showing the " .. theme .. " set on the ship: " .. n .. " skins" .. (tab.body and " + body colours" or "") .. ".", "ok")
end

PreviewTab.pick = function(theme) pickTheme(theme) end

-- LIST ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- highest tier first; skins with no tier anywhere last
local NO_TIER = "No tier"
local TIER_RANK = { "Legendary", "Epic", "Rare", "Common", NO_TIER }
local listFetched = false
local renderThemeRow
local renderTierPicker

-- a skin's tier: the website's (the live price) when it has one, else the catalogue row's
local function skinTier(s)
	local web = Website.get(s.key, s.slot)
	if type(web) == "table" and web.tier then return Slots.TIERS[web.tier] end
	local cat = ShipSkins.catalogData()
	local e = cat and cat[s.slot] and cat[s.slot][s.key]
	return e and Theme.TIER[e.tier] and e.tier or nil
end

function PreviewTab.renderList()
	local list = ctx.ui.list
	for _, c in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
		if not c:IsA("UIListLayout") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	local q = ctx.query():lower()
	local skins = ShipSkins.scan()

	-- each skin's tier (website first, else the catalogue); ask the website once for the rest
	local unknown = {}
	local byTheme, totals = {}, {}
	for _, s in ipairs(skins) do
		if Website.get(s.key, s.slot) == nil then table.insert(unknown, s.key) end
		local tier = skinTier(s) or NO_TIER
		totals[tier] = (totals[tier] or 0) + 1
		local t = ShipSkins.themeOf(s)
		if t then
			local b = byTheme[t] or { n = 0, tiers = {} }
			byTheme[t] = b
			b.n += 1
			b.tiers[tier] = (b.tiers[tier] or 0) + 1
		end
	end
	if #unknown > 0 and Website.ownerToken() and not listFetched then
		listFetched = true
		task.spawn(function()
			Website.fetch(unknown)
			if ctx.active() then PreviewTab.renderList() end
		end)
	end

	-- SKINS PER TIER, on top
	local sum = Theme.card(nil, 0, { Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 0) })
	T(#skins .. " ship skins by tier" .. ((#unknown > 0 and Website.ownerToken()) and "  ·  asking the website…" or ""),
		{ FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = sum
	local grid = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 2 },
		{ new("UIGridLayout", { CellSize = UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 0, 22), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }) })
	for i, tier in ipairs(TIER_RANK) do
		local c = Theme.TIER[tier] or col.dim
		local cell = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = i }, {
			new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -4), BackgroundColor3 = c, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, { Theme.corner(4) }),
			T(tier, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -54, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, TextWrapped = false,
				TextColor3 = tier == NO_TIER and col.dim or col.text }),
			T(tostring(totals[tier] or 0), { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 1, 0),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextColor3 = c }),
		})
		cell.Parent = grid
	end
	grid.Parent = sum
	sum.Parent = list

	-- THEMES, grouped by the tier most of their skins have (highest tier first)
	local groups = {}
	for _, th in ipairs(ctx.themes()) do
		local b = byTheme[th.key]
		if b and (q == "" or th.key:lower():find(q, 1, true)) then
			local best, bestN = NO_TIER, 0
			for _, tier in ipairs(TIER_RANK) do
				local n = b.tiers[tier] or 0
				if tier ~= NO_TIER and n > bestN then best, bestN = tier, n end
			end
			groups[best] = groups[best] or {}
			table.insert(groups[best], { key = th.key, n = b.n, mixed = (b.tiers[best] or 0) < b.n, tiers = b.tiers })
		end
	end
	local order = 0
	for _, tier in ipairs(TIER_RANK) do
		local g = groups[tier]
		if g then
			table.sort(g, function(a, b) return a.key:lower() < b.key:lower() end)
			local skinsIn = 0
			for _, th in ipairs(g) do skinsIn += th.n end
			order += 1
			T(tier:upper() .. "  ·  " .. #g .. (#g == 1 and " theme" or " themes") .. ", " .. skinsIn .. " skins",
				{ FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = Theme.TIER[tier] or col.dim, LayoutOrder = order,
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Bottom }).Parent = list
			for _, th in ipairs(g) do
				order += 1
				renderThemeRow(list, th, tier, order)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- one theme row: name, a "mixed" hint when its skins are not all the group's tier, the count
function renderThemeRow(list, th, tier, order)
	local n = th.n
	local sel = tab.theme == th.key
	local row = new("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = order,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), BackgroundColor3 = sel and col.selected or col.bg, BackgroundTransparency = sel and 0 or 1 },
		{ Theme.corner(6),
			T(th.key, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -150, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
				TextWrapped = false, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, FontFace = sel and Theme.fontMedium or Theme.font }) })
	if th.mixed then
		-- e.g. "3R 1E 1–": how the theme's skins really split
		local parts = {}
		for _, t in ipairs(TIER_RANK) do
			if th.tiers[t] then table.insert(parts, th.tiers[t] .. (t == NO_TIER and "–" or t:sub(1, 1))) end
		end
		T(table.concat(parts, " "), { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -86, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 70, 1, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = col.dim,
			TextWrapped = false }).Parent = row
	end
	Theme.pill(n .. (n == 1 and " SKIN" or " SKINS"), Theme.TIER[tier] or col.accent,
		{ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0) }).Parent = row
	row.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if tab.theme ~= th.key then row.BackgroundTransparency = 0 row.BackgroundColor3 = col.hover end end)
	row.MouseLeave:Connect(function() if tab.theme ~= th.key then row.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end end)
	row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		pickTheme(th.key)
		PreviewTab.renderList()
		PreviewTab.renderDetail()
	end)
	row.Parent = list
end

-- DETAIL --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function nudge(skin, piece, t, label)
	-- moving the MOUNTED piece by t (socket space) = pivot P becomes P * t⁻¹
	local ok, err = recorded(label .. " " .. piece.Name, function()
		Preview.setPivot(piece, piece.PivotOffset * t:Inverse())
	end)
	if not ok then ctx.toast(tostring(err), "bad") end
end

local function rescale(piece, factor)
	recorded("Scale " .. piece.Name, function() Preview.scale(piece, factor) end)
end

local function attrEditor(model, order)
	local card = Theme.card("Attributes of " .. model.Name, order)
	local names = {}
	for k in pairs(model:GetAttributes()) do
		if k:sub(1, 4) ~= "RBX_" then table.insert(names, k) end
	end
	table.sort(names)
	if #names == 0 then
		T("This model has no attributes.", { TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = card
		return card
	end
	for i, k in ipairs(names) do
		local v = model:GetAttribute(k)
		local kind = typeof(v)
		local row = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), LayoutOrder = i })
		T(k, { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 13, Size = UDim2.new(0.38, -6, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextWrapped = false }).Parent = row
		local function show(x)
			local t = typeof(x)
			if t == "Color3" then return Theme.rgb(x) end
			if t == "Vector3" then return string.format("%.3f, %.3f, %.3f", x.X, x.Y, x.Z) end
			if t == "number" then return string.format("%.4g", x) end
			if t == "Font" then return x.Family:match("([^/]+)%.json$") or x.Family end
			if t == "CFrame" then return string.format("pos %.3f, %.3f, %.3f", x.X, x.Y, x.Z) end
			return tostring(x)
		end
		if kind == "boolean" then
			local b
			b = Theme.button(v and "On" or "Off", v and "primary" or "secondary", function()
				recorded("Attribute " .. k, function() model:SetAttribute(k, not model:GetAttribute(k)) end)
				PreviewTab.renderDetail()
			end, { Position = UDim2.new(0.38, 0, 0, 1), Size = UDim2.new(0, 70, 0, 28), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None })
			b.Parent = row
		elseif kind == "number" or kind == "string" or kind == "Vector3" or kind == "Color3" then
			if kind == "Color3" then
				new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0.38, 0, 0.5, -10), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20), BackgroundColor3 = v, BorderSizePixel = 0 },
					{ Theme.corner(5), Theme.stroke(col.cardStroke) }).Parent = row
			end
			local off = kind == "Color3" and 28 or 0
			local box = Theme.input("", show(v), { Position = UDim2.new(0.38, off, 0, 1), Size = UDim2.new(0.62, -off, 0, 28),
				FontFace = Theme.fontMono, TextSize = 12 })
			box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local txt = box.Text
				local nv
				if kind == "number" then
					nv = tonumber(txt)
				elseif kind == "string" then
					nv = txt
				elseif kind == "Vector3" then
					local a, b, c = txt:match("^%s*(%-?[%d%.]+)[,%s]+(%-?[%d%.]+)[,%s]+(%-?[%d%.]+)%s*$")
					nv = a and Vector3.new(tonumber(a), tonumber(b), tonumber(c)) or nil
				elseif kind == "Color3" then
					nv = Theme.parseColor(txt)
				end
				if nv ~= nil then
					recorded("Attribute " .. k, function() model:SetAttribute(k, nv) end)
					ctx.toast(k .. " = " .. show(nv), "ok")
				else
					box.Text = show(model:GetAttribute(k))
					ctx.toast("Could not read '" .. txt .. "' as a " .. kind .. ".", "warn")
				end
			end)
			box.Parent = row
		else
			T(show(v) .. "  (" .. kind .. ", edit in Properties)", { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12,
				Position = UDim2.new(0.38, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.62, 0, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None }).Parent = row
		end
		row.Parent = card
	end
	return card
end

-- LIGHT & VFX: a lantern's light and flame are PROPERTIES of CandleRig.Fitile's PointLight and
-- its ParticleEmitters (CandleFire / CandleLight / CandleSmoke), not attributes. Approve copies
-- that Fitile into SkinAppearances, so these are exactly what the game shows.
local function fmt(x) return string.format("%.3g", x) end

local function editRow(card, order, label, current, parse, apply, swatch)
	local row = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), LayoutOrder = order })
	T(label, { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 13, Size = UDim2.new(0.38, -6, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
		TextWrapped = false, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd }).Parent = row
	local off = 0
	if swatch then
		new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0.38, 0, 0.5, -10), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20), BackgroundColor3 = swatch, BorderSizePixel = 0 },
			{ Theme.corner(5), Theme.stroke(col.cardStroke) }).Parent = row
		off = 28
	end
	local box = Theme.input("", current, { Position = UDim2.new(0.38, off, 0, 1), Size = UDim2.new(0.62, -off, 0, 28), FontFace = Theme.fontMono, TextSize = 12 })
	box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		local v = parse(box.Text)
		if v == nil then
			box.Text = current
			ctx.toast("Could not read '" .. box.Text .. "'.", "warn")
			return
		end
		recorded(label, function() apply(v) end)
		PreviewTab.renderDetail()
	end)
	box.Parent = row
	row.Parent = card
end

local function num(s) return tonumber((s:gsub("%s", ""))) end
local function range(s)
	local a, b = s:match("^%s*(%-?[%d%.]+)%s*[%-–,to%s]+%s*(%-?[%d%.]+)%s*$")
	if a then return NumberRange.new(math.min(tonumber(a), tonumber(b)), math.max(tonumber(a), tonumber(b))) end
	local one = tonumber((s:gsub("%s", "")))
	return one and NumberRange.new(one) or nil
end

local function lightEditor(model, order)
	local rig = model:FindFirstChild("CandleRig")
	local fitile = rig and rig:FindFirstChild("Fitile")
	if not fitile then return nil end
	local card = Theme.card("Light & VFX of " .. model.Name, order)
	T("CandleRig.Fitile — what the game shows on every lantern of this skin. Colours: r, g, b or #hex.",
		{ TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = card
	local o = 0
	local function nextOrder() o += 1 return o end
	for _, light in ipairs(fitile:GetChildren()) do
		if light:IsA("Light") then
			T(light.Name, { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 13, LayoutOrder = nextOrder() }).Parent = card
			editRow(card, nextOrder(), "Colour", Theme.rgb(light.Color), Theme.parseColor, function(v) light.Color = v end, light.Color)
			editRow(card, nextOrder(), "Brightness", fmt(light.Brightness), num, function(v) light.Brightness = v end)
			if light:IsA("PointLight") or light:IsA("SpotLight") then
				editRow(card, nextOrder(), "Range", fmt(light.Range), num, function(v) light.Range = v end)
			end
			local sh = Theme.row(8, nextOrder(), 30)
			T("Shadows", { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 13, Size = UDim2.new(0.38, -6, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None }).Parent = sh
			Theme.button(light.Shadows and "On" or "Off", light.Shadows and "primary" or "secondary", function()
				recorded("Shadows", function() light.Shadows = not light.Shadows end)
				PreviewTab.renderDetail()
			end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = sh
			sh.Parent = card
		end
	end
	for _, e in ipairs(fitile:GetChildren()) do
		if e:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			local kp = e.Color.Keypoints
			local c0, c1 = kp[1].Value, kp[#kp].Value
			local head = Theme.row(8, nextOrder(), 30)
			T(e.Name, { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 13, Size = UDim2.new(0.38, -6, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None }).Parent = head
			Theme.button(e.Enabled and "On" or "Off", e.Enabled and "primary" or "secondary", function()
				recorded(e.Name .. " on/off", function() e.Enabled = not e.Enabled end)
				PreviewTab.renderDetail()
			end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = head
			head.Parent = card
			editRow(card, nextOrder(), "Start colour", Theme.rgb(c0), Theme.parseColor, function(v)
				local k = e.Color.Keypoints
				k[1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, v)
				e.Color = ColorSequence.new(k)
			end, c0)
			editRow(card, nextOrder(), "End colour", Theme.rgb(c1), Theme.parseColor, function(v)
				local k = e.Color.Keypoints
				k[#k] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, v)
				e.Color = ColorSequence.new(k)
			end, c1)
			editRow(card, nextOrder(), "Rate", fmt(e.Rate), num, function(v) e.Rate = v end)
			local sk = e.Size.Keypoints
			editRow(card, nextOrder(), "Size (start)", fmt(sk[1].Value), num, function(v)
				-- scale the whole size curve so its shape is kept
				local k = e.Size.Keypoints
				local f = (k[1].Value ~= 0) and (v / k[1].Value) or nil
				local out = {}
				for i, p in ipairs(k) do
					out[i] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(p.Time, f and p.Value * f or (i == 1 and v or p.Value), p.Envelope)
				end
				e.Size = NumberSequence.new(out)
			end)
			editRow(card, nextOrder(), "Lifetime (min – max)", fmt(e.Lifetime.Min) .. " – " .. fmt(e.Lifetime.Max), range, function(v) e.Lifetime = v end)
			editRow(card, nextOrder(), "Speed (min – max)", fmt(e.Speed.Min) .. " – " .. fmt(e.Speed.Max), range, function(v) e.Speed = v end)
			editRow(card, nextOrder(), "Light emission", fmt(e.LightEmission), num, function(v) e.LightEmission = math.clamp(v, 0, 1) end)
			local tk = e.Transparency.Keypoints
			editRow(card, nextOrder(), "Transparency (start)", fmt(tk[1].Value), num, function(v)
				local k = e.Transparency.Keypoints
				k[1] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, math.clamp(v, 0, 1), k[1].Envelope)
				e.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(k)
			end)
		end
	end
	return card
end

-- THEME TIER (owner only: needs the website token) ------------------------------------------
-- One tier for every skin of the theme, on the website (Robux product) and in the game (gold
-- price, economy itemTier) in ONE change: Check runs it as a dry run, Apply writes it.
local TIERS = { { "common", "Common" }, { "rare", "Rare" }, { "epic", "Epic" }, { "legendary", "Legendary" } }
local tierState = { theme = nil, pick = nil, plan = nil, busy = false, fetched = {} }

local function themeSkins(theme)
	local skins, names = {}, {}
	for _, s in ipairs(ShipSkins.scan()) do
		if ShipSkins.inTheme(s, theme) then
			table.insert(skins, s)
			table.insert(names, s.key)
		end
	end
	return skins, names
end

local function cap(s)
	if type(s) == "table" then s = s.tier end -- the website answers from / to as { tier, price, exclusive }
	return type(s) == "string" and (s:sub(1, 1):upper() .. s:sub(2)) or "no tier"
end

local function renderThemeTier(head)
	local theme = tab.theme
	if tierState.theme ~= theme then
		tierState.theme, tierState.pick, tierState.plan = theme, nil, nil
	end
	local skins, names = themeSkins(theme)

	-- what the website says now; ask once per theme when some are not known yet
	local now, missing, unknown = {}, {}, false
	for _, s in ipairs(skins) do
		local n = s.key
		local row = Website.get(n, s.slot)
		if row == nil then
			unknown = true
		elseif row == false or not row.merch then
			table.insert(missing, n)
		else
			local t = row.tier and cap(row.tier) or "No tier"
			now[t] = (now[t] or 0) + 1
		end
	end
	if unknown and not tierState.fetched[theme] then
		tierState.fetched[theme] = true
		task.spawn(function()
			Website.fetch(names)
			if tab.theme == theme then PreviewTab.renderDetail() end
		end)
	end
	local parts = {}
	for _, t in ipairs({ "Common", "Rare", "Epic", "Legendary", "No tier" }) do
		if now[t] then table.insert(parts, now[t] .. " " .. t) end
	end
	if #missing > 0 then table.insert(parts, #missing .. " not for sale on the website") end

	T("THEME TIER  ·  owner", { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 50 }).Parent = head
	T("Sets every " .. theme .. " skin (" .. #names .. ") to one tier: the website's Robux product and the game's gold price, in one change. "
		.. (unknown and "Asking the website what they are now…" or ("Now: " .. (#parts > 0 and table.concat(parts, ", ") or "nothing on the website") .. ".")),
		{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 60 }).Parent = head

	-- narrow dock: the actions get their own line under the tiers
	local r3 = Theme.row(8, 70, 32)
	local actions = tab.narrow and Theme.row(8, 75, 32) or r3
	Theme.segmented(TIERS, tierState.pick or "", function(k)
		tierState.pick, tierState.plan = k, nil
		PreviewTab.renderDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = r3
	local checkB, checkApi = Theme.button(tierState.busy and "Working…" or "Check", "secondary", function()
		if tierState.busy or not tierState.pick then return end
		tierState.busy = true
		PreviewTab.renderDetail()
		local ok, data = Website.setTiers(skins, tierState.pick, true)
		tierState.busy = false
		if ok then
			tierState.plan = { tier = tierState.pick, data = data }
		else
			ctx.toast(data, "bad")
		end
		PreviewTab.renderDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 2 })
	checkApi.setEnabled(tierState.pick ~= nil and not tierState.busy)
	checkB.Parent = actions
	local plan = tierState.plan
	local willChange = plan and ((plan.data.would_update or 0) > 0 or (plan.data.game_changed or 0) > 0)
	local applyB, applyApi = Theme.button(plan and ("Apply " .. cap(plan.tier) .. " to " .. (plan.data.would_update or 0) .. " skins") or "Apply",
		"primary", function()
		if tierState.busy or not plan then return end
		tierState.busy = true
		PreviewTab.renderDetail()
		local ok, data = Website.setTiers(skins, plan.tier, false)
		tierState.busy = false
		tierState.plan = nil
		if ok then
			local msg = (data.updated or 0) .. " set to " .. cap(plan.tier) .. " on the website"
				.. (data.game_published and ", game gold tiers published" or "")
				.. (data.game_error and (" — game NOT published: " .. tostring(data.game_error)) or "")
				.. ((data.failed or 0) > 0 and (" · " .. data.failed .. " refused") or "") .. "."
			ctx.toast(msg, data.game_error and "warn" or "ok")
			tierState.fetched[theme] = nil
		else
			ctx.toast(data, "bad")
		end
		PreviewTab.renderDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 3 })
	applyApi.setEnabled(willChange and not tierState.busy or false)
	applyB.Parent = actions
	r3.Parent = head
	if actions ~= r3 then actions.Parent = head end

	-- the dry run, in words: what changes, what is refused and why, and the game side
	if plan then
		local lines = {}
		local byStatus = { ["would update"] = {}, unchanged = {}, failed = {} }
		for _, r in ipairs(plan.data.results or {}) do
			local list = byStatus[r.status]
			if list then
				table.insert(list, r.status == "would update" and (r.asset .. " " .. cap(r.from) .. "→" .. cap(r.to))
					or r.status == "failed" and (r.asset .. ": " .. tostring(r.message or "refused"))
					or r.asset)
			end
		end
		if #byStatus["would update"] > 0 then table.insert(lines, "Will change: " .. table.concat(byStatus["would update"], ", ")) end
		if #byStatus.unchanged > 0 then table.insert(lines, "Already " .. cap(plan.tier) .. ": " .. table.concat(byStatus.unchanged, ", ")) end
		if #byStatus.failed > 0 then table.insert(lines, "Refused (left as they are): " .. table.concat(byStatus.failed, " · ")) end
		if plan.data.game_error then
			table.insert(lines, "Game: NOT published — " .. tostring(plan.data.game_error))
		elseif plan.data.game_would_publish then
			table.insert(lines, "Game: " .. tostring(plan.data.game_changed) .. " gold tiers will be published.")
		elseif plan.data.game_message then
			table.insert(lines, "Game: " .. tostring(plan.data.game_message))
		end
		if plan.data.game_warning then table.insert(lines, "Warning: " .. tostring(plan.data.game_warning)) end
		if not willChange then table.insert(lines, "Nothing to change.") end
		T(table.concat(lines, "\n"), { TextColor3 = #byStatus.failed > 0 and col.warn or col.text, LayoutOrder = 80 }).Parent = head
	end
end

-- TIER FOR ONE SKIN (owner) ------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Opened from a set row's tier chip. Picks the tier (and, for a skin not on sale yet,
-- Exclusive = season pass / bundle only, no price): the website's Robux product and the
-- game's gold price change together, like the Ship skins tab's Tier card. The website only
-- tiers a skin that is on sale — a price (set on the Merch page) or Exclusive.
function renderTierPicker(parent, skin, order)
	local box = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = col.raised, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = order }, { Theme.corner(6), Theme.pad(8, 10, 8, 10), Theme.vlist(6) })
	local web = Website.get(skin.key, skin.slot)
	local onSale = type(web) == "table" and (web.price ~= nil or web.exclusive == true)
	T("Tier for " .. skin.key .. (type(web) == "table" and (web.price and ("  ·  " .. web.price .. " gold") or (web.exclusive and "  ·  Exclusive" or "  ·  no price yet: Set tier puts it on sale at the tier price")) or "  ·  not on the website"),
		{ TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = box
	local r1 = Theme.row(8, 2, 30)
	Theme.segmented(TIERS, tab.tierPick or "", function(k)
		tab.tierPick = k
		PreviewTab.renderDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = r1
	r1.Parent = box
	local r2 = Theme.row(8, 3, 30)
	if not onSale then
		Theme.segmented({ { "no", "On sale at tier price" }, { "yes", "Exclusive" } }, tab.tierExclusive and "yes" or "no", function(k)
			tab.tierExclusive = k == "yes" or nil
			PreviewTab.renderDetail()
		end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = r2
	end
	local setB, setApi = Theme.button(tierState.busy and "Working…" or "Set tier", "primary", function()
		if tierState.busy or not tab.tierPick then return end
		tierState.busy = true
		PreviewTab.renderDetail()
		local ok, msg = Website.setTier(skin.key, tab.tierPick, tab.tierExclusive, skin.slot)
		tierState.busy = false
		if ok then
			tab.tierEdit = nil
			tierState.fetched[tab.theme] = nil
			Website.fetch({ skin.key })
		end
		ctx.toast(ok and (skin.key .. ": " .. tostring(msg))
			or tostring(msg),
			ok and "ok" or "bad")
		PreviewTab.renderList()
		PreviewTab.renderDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 2 })
	setApi.setEnabled(tab.tierPick ~= nil and not tierState.busy and type(web) == "table")
	setB.Parent = r2
	Theme.button("Cancel", "ghost", function()
		tab.tierEdit = nil
		PreviewTab.renderDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 3 }).Parent = r2
	r2.Parent = box
	box.Parent = parent
end

local NARROW = 600 -- detail width (px) below which the set rows stack
local widthConn
function PreviewTab.renderDetail()
	local d = ctx.ui.detail
	tab.narrow = d.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 and d.AbsoluteSize.X < NARROW
	if not widthConn then
		-- re-lay the rows when the dock is resized across the threshold
		widthConn = d:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
			local narrow = d.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 and d.AbsoluteSize.X < NARROW
			if narrow ~= tab.narrow and ctx.active() then PreviewTab.renderDetail() end
		end)
	end
	for _, c in ipairs(d:GetChildren()) do
		if not (c:IsA("UIListLayout") or c:IsA("UIPadding")) then c:Destroy() end
	end
	if not tab.theme then
		local empty = Theme.card(nil, 1)
		T("Pick a theme on the left to see the whole set on the ship.", { FontFace = Theme.fontMedium, TextSize = 16, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = empty
		T("Then swap any slot, nudge pieces, drag them on the ship and take the edits back, tune the model's attributes, and flip day / night to judge the lights.",
			{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = empty
		empty.Parent = d
		return
	end

	-- HEADER + LIGHTING
	local head = Theme.card(nil, 1)
	T(tab.theme .. " — the whole set", { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 20, LayoutOrder = 10 }).Parent = head
	T("On " .. Preview.SHIP_NAME .. ", placed by the game's own code. Everything you change here is a real edit of the Assets models (Ctrl+Z undoes each).",
		{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 20 }).Parent = head
	-- narrow dock: the body switch and Restore lighting drop to their own lines
	local r1 = Theme.row(8, 30, 32)
	local bodyRow = tab.narrow and Theme.row(8, 35, 32) or r1
	Theme.button("Whole ship", "secondary", function() Preview.focusShip() end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = r1
	Theme.button("Re-dress", "secondary", function() apply() ctx.toast("Ship re-dressed.", "ok") end, { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = r1
	Theme.segmented({ { "theme", "Theme body" }, { "default", "Default body" } }, tab.body and "theme" or "default", function(k)
		tab.body = k == "theme"
		apply()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 3 }).Parent = bodyRow
	r1.Parent = head
	if bodyRow ~= r1 then bodyRow.Parent = head end
	-- time of day: the top bar (Studio / Day / Sunset / Night), for every tab
	if Website.ownerToken() then renderThemeTier(head) end
	head.Parent = d

	-- THE SET
	local setCard = Theme.card("The set", 2)
	local all = bySlot()
	local order = 0
	for _, slot in ipairs(Slots.ORDER) do
		local list = all[slot]
		if list and #list > 0 then
			order += 1
			local cur = tab.set[slot] or "Default"
			local options = { "Default" }
			for _, s in ipairs(list) do table.insert(options, s.key) end
			local idx = table.find(options, cur) or 1
			-- narrow dock: the slot name gets its own small line so the skin name keeps its room
			local narrow = tab.narrow
			local y = narrow and 18 or 0
			local x = narrow and 0 or 84
			local row = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, narrow and 50 or 32), LayoutOrder = order * 2 })
			T(slot, narrow and { FontFace = Theme.fontMedium, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = col.dim, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None }
				or { FontFace = Theme.fontMedium, Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None }).Parent = row
			local controls = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32) })
			controls.Parent = row
			local function step(dir)
				local n = ((idx - 1 + dir) % #options) + 1
				tab.set[slot] = options[n] ~= "Default" and options[n] or nil
				apply()
				PreviewTab.renderDetail()
			end
			Theme.button("‹", "secondary", function() step(-1) end, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, 1), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None }).Parent = controls
			-- the skin's tier: a chip; the owner clicks it to pick or give one (website + game gold)
			local curSkin = cur ~= "Default" and find(slot, cur) or nil
			if curSkin then
				local tier = skinTier(curSkin)
				local chip = Theme.button(tier and tier:sub(1, 1) or "–", "secondary", function()
					if not Website.ownerToken() then
						ctx.toast("Tier is the owner's: it changes the website and the game price.", "warn")
						return
					end
					if tab.tierEdit == slot then
						tab.tierEdit = nil
					else
						tab.tierEdit, tab.tierPick, tab.tierExclusive = slot, tier and tier:lower() or nil, nil
					end
					PreviewTab.renderDetail()
				end, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x + 36, 3), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
					TextSize = 12, FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextColor3 = tier and Theme.TIER[tier] or col.dim })
				chip.Parent = controls
				if tab.tierEdit == slot then chip.BackgroundColor3 = col.selected end
			end
			local nameX = x + 36 + (curSkin and 32 or 0)
			local nameProps = { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(nameX, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -(nameX + (narrow and 168 or 210)), 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextWrapped = false,
				TextColor3 = cur == "Default" and col.dim or col.text }
			if curSkin then
				-- the name is a link: it opens this skin in the Ship skins tab (checks, setup, tier, approve)
				local link = new("TextButton", nameProps)
				link.Text = cur
				link.FontFace = Theme.font
				link.TextSize = 14
				link.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				link.AutoButtonColor = false
				link.MouseEnter:Connect(function() link.TextColor3 = col.accent link.FontFace = Theme.fontMedium end)
				link.MouseLeave:Connect(function() link.TextColor3 = col.text link.FontFace = Theme.font end)
				link.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() ctx.openSkin(cur) end)
				link.Parent = controls
			else
				T(cur, nameProps).Parent = controls
			end
			Theme.button("›", "secondary", function() step(1) end, { Position = UDim2.new(1, narrow and -162 or -204, 0, 1), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None }).Parent = controls
			Theme.button("Look", "ghost", function() Preview.focus(slot, 1) end, { Position = UDim2.new(1, narrow and -124 or -166, 0, 1),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(narrow and 52 or 60, 30), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = controls
			local adj, adjApi = Theme.button(tab.focus == slot and "Adjusting" or "Adjust", tab.focus == slot and "primary" or "secondary", function()
				tab.focus = slot
				tab.piece = 1
				Preview.focus(slot, 1)
				PreviewTab.renderDetail()
			end, { Position = UDim2.new(1, narrow and -68 or -100, 0, 1), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(narrow and 68 or 100, 30), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, TextSize = 12 })
			adjApi.setEnabled(cur ~= "Default")
			adj.Parent = controls
			row.Parent = setCard
			if curSkin and tab.tierEdit == slot then renderTierPicker(setCard, curSkin, order * 2 + 1) end
		end
	end
	setCard.Parent = d

	-- ADJUST
	local slot = tab.focus
	local skin = slot and tab.set[slot] and find(slot, tab.set[slot])
	if skin then
		local ac = Theme.card("Adjust " .. slot .. " — " .. skin.key, 3)
		local pieces = {}
		if Slots.SHIP[slot].texture then
			T("A sail is a texture — nothing to move. Tune its SurfaceAppearance in Properties.", { TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = ac
		else
			for _, p in ipairs(skin.model:GetChildren()) do
				if p:IsA("MeshPart") then table.insert(pieces, p) end
			end
			tab.piece = math.clamp(tab.piece, 1, math.max(#pieces, 1))
			local opts = {}
			for i, p in ipairs(pieces) do table.insert(opts, { i, p.Name }) end
			if #opts > 0 then
				local seg = Theme.segmented(opts, tab.piece, function(i)
					tab.piece = i
					PreviewTab.renderDetail()
				end, { LayoutOrder = 1 })
				seg.Parent = ac
			end
			local piece = pieces[tab.piece]
			if piece then
				local pv = piece.PivotOffset
				local rx, ry, rz = pv:ToOrientation()
				T(string.format("Pivot  %.3f, %.3f, %.3f   ·   turned %.1f°, %.1f°, %.1f°   ·   size %.3f, %.3f, %.3f",
					pv.X, pv.Y, pv.Z, math.deg(rx), math.deg(ry), math.deg(rz), piece.Size.X, piece.Size.Y, piece.Size.Z),
					{ FontFace = Theme.fontMono, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = ac
				local steps = Theme.row(8, 3, 30)
				T("Step", { TextColor3 = col.dim, Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = steps
